docs.title: 自定义节点
docs.text:
自定义节点适用于内置节点无法表达的绘制.如果你能用现有节点组合出来,就不要自定义

本章将会介绍如何继承GuiNode,如何调用GuiRender的方法,如何响应事件.什么场景值得自定义取决于你的项目,如果某个需求足够普遍,库会提供内置节点

docs.title: 如何制作
docs.text:
你的自定义节点应该继承GuiNode<?>抽象类,并且泛型参数填自己的类型,如Frame extends GuiNode<Frame>

如果你最终决定自己制作自定义节点,那么你必须直接调用我们的渲染抽象层

你的类继承GuiNode后,必须重写render(GuiRender render, double delta)方法,其中delta单位为毫秒,当前版本我们不推荐使用delta来做动画,我们推荐使用Tween来做,Tween介绍在上一章节

你的构造函数应该至少拥有ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size并调用super(position, size)

你的所有setter方法应当返回this,如果你造的是抽象类那么请你定义为:Example<T extends Example<T>> extends GuiNode<T>并且所有setter返回T(使用父类字段self)

如果你希望绘制默认背景,请调用父类字段background的render方法,如果你的背景绘制是可选的,请加drawBackground属性(字段,setter与getter)并实现HasDrawBackground接口,泛型填自己的类型,默认值由节点类型自由决定

示例:最简单的仅仅调用父类background字段的render方法的Frame类

public class Frame extends GuiNode<Frame> {
    @Override
    protected void render(GuiRender render, double delta) {
        background.render(render);
    }

    public Frame(ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size) {
        super(position, size);
    }
}

示例:可选绘制背景的DemoFrame类

public class DemoFrame extends GuiNode<DemoFrame> implements HasDrawBackground<DemoFrame> {
    private boolean drawBackground = false;

    @Override
    public DemoFrame setDrawBackground(boolean drawBackground) {
        this.drawBackground = drawBackground;
        return self;
    }
    @Override
    public boolean isDrawBackground() {
        return drawBackground;
    }

    @Override
    protected void render(GuiRender render, double delta) {
        if (drawBackground) {
            background.render(render);
        }
    }

    public DemoFrame(ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size) {
        super(position, size);
    }
}

docs.title: 事件
docs.text:
你的节点可以任意监听你想要监听的事件

onXxx是给你的自定义节点重写用的钩子,dispatchXxx(包括dispatchRender)是分发流程,一般不需要重写

如果你仅仅是为了判断鼠标是否在节点内,建议使用父类的字段protected boolean mouseInNode

父类还帮你维护了目前有哪些鼠标按键点击了节点,protected Set<MouseButton> currentMouseClickButtons,如果你想取消事件的话你可以选择重写

示例:某Button的onMouseButtonEvent方法

@Override
    protected void onMouseButtonEvent(MouseButtonEvent event) {
        if (!Collections.disjoint(canTriggerMouseButtons, currentMouseClickButtons)) { //canTriggerMouseButtons是该节点自己的字段
            event.cancel();
            mouseButtonEventListenerRegistry.trigger(self, event); //self是ParentNode继承来的字段,类型为T
        }
    }

目前有这些方法可重写,重写之后在方法体内编写你想要的任何后续处理即可

//可取消事件(event.cancel()可用,调用会阻止后续分发)
protected void onKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseButtonEvent(MouseButtonEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseMoveEvent(MouseMoveEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseEnterWindowEvent(MouseEnterWindowEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseLeaveWindowEvent(MouseLeaveWindowEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseScrollEvent(MouseScrollEvent event) {}
protected void onUserInputTextEvent(UserInputTextEvent event) {}
protected void onUserRequestWindowCloseEvent(UserRequestWindowCloseEvent event) {} //它如果取消了不光会阻止事件分发还会让窗口不关闭
protected void onUserDropFilesEvent(UserDropFilesEvent event) {}

//不可取消事件
protected void onWindowMinimizeEvent(WindowMinimizeEvent event) {}
protected void onWindowMaximizeEvent(WindowMaximizeEvent event) {}
protected void onWindowMoveEvent(WindowMoveEvent event) {}
protected void onWindowCloseEvent(WindowCloseEvent event) {}
protected void onWindowFocusChangeEvent(WindowFocusChangeEvent event) {}
protected void onFrameBufferSizeChangeEvent(FrameBufferSizeChangeEvent event) {}
protected void onPreeditEvent(PreeditEvent event) {} //输入法的预编辑事件
protected void onRelayout() {} //需要重算布局时会调用该方法
protected void onWindowFocusNodeChangeEvent(ParentNode<?> oldFocusNode, ParentNode<?> newFocusNode) {}
protected void tick() {} //每秒固定60次,帧数不足60会每次渲染开头补回来
protected void init(GuiRender render) {} //节点第一次加入节点树时触发,此时parent,root绝对不会是null,该事件不会触发第二次

Warning

某些父节点如TextNode,ImageNode,LayoutBox自己就重写了onRelayout,因此请你调用一次super.onRelayout()

docs.title: 中间层节点父类
docs.text: 本章节将会讲解几个节点的中间层抽象类,它们将提供某些方面的便捷API/类以供你使用

docs.title: ImageNode
docs.text:
ImageNode是图像节点的抽象基类,继承GuiNode,它内部定义了public class ImageRenderDescription(非static),这个类型拥有渲染一个图片所需的所有数据,所有方法返回它本身,以及getNode方法返回外部类

如果你要做的节点有图片,可以继承ImageNode

如果你要渲染ImageRenderDescription,调用render(GuiRender render)

如果你的节点有多个图片要管理,你可以像ImageButton的这三个方法设计你的API,normal,onHover,onClick,返回该状态对应的ImageRenderDescription

public ImageRenderDescription normal() {
    return normal;
}
public ImageRenderDescription onHover() {
    return onHover;
}
public ImageRenderDescription onClick() {
    return onClick;
}

Info

因为ImageRenderDescription的getNode()方法直接返回外部类,因此你只需要提供返回ImageRenderDescription的方法

示例:使用ImageRenderDescription并继承ImageNode的ImageLabel类

public class ImageLabel extends ImageNode<ImageLabel> implements HasDrawBackground<ImageLabel> {
    private final ImageRenderDescription imageRenderDescription;
    private boolean drawBackground = true;

    @Override
    public void render(GuiRender render, double delta) {
        if (drawBackground) background.render(render);
        imageRenderDescription.render(render);
    }

    @Override
    public ImageLabel setDrawBackground(boolean drawBackground) {
        this.drawBackground = drawBackground;
        return this;
    }
    @Override
    public boolean isDrawBackground() {
        return drawBackground;
    }

    public ImageRenderDescription getImageRenderDescription() {
        return imageRenderDescription;
    }

    @Override
    public void onRelayout() {
        operationImageAlignment();
    }

    private void operationImageAlignment() {
        imageRenderDescription.operationImageAlignment();
    }

    public ImageLabel(Texture texture, ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size) {
        super(position, size);
        this.imageRenderDescription = new ImageRenderDescription().setTexture(texture);
    }
}

docs.title: TextNode
docs.text:
TextNode是文字节点的抽象基类,继承GuiNode,它内部定义了

public abstract class AbstractTextRenderDescription

public class TextRenderDescription

public class CanWrappedTextRenderDescription

AbstractTextRenderDescription是非静态抽象基类,持有一个文字渲染所需的所有数据,比如字体,使用的相对于节点的对齐等

TextRenderDescription仅仅继承AbstractTextRenderDescription,泛型填TextRenderDescription,不添加额外行为

CanWrappedTextRenderDescription增加了wrap字段,setWrap与isWrap方法,用于控制自动换行

如果你要制作的节点要渲染文本,可以继承TextNode

Warning

CanWrappedTextRenderDescription会根据\n与节点宽度,各个字符的宽度自动换行,而TextRenderDescription就算遇见\n也不换行,且会渲染为notdef

如果你要渲染它们,调用render(GuiRender render)

Info

因为AbstractTextRenderDescription的getNode()方法直接返回外部类,因此你只需要提供返回RenderDescription的方法

Info

TextLabel使用了CanWrappedTextRenderDescription,而TextBox的输入框则使用了TextRenderDescription

docs.text:
你可能会疑惑,我无法同时继承TextNode和ImageNode,那我怎么制作又有Text又有Image的节点?

答案是:如果你真的要同时渲染它们,我们推荐你使用组合节点的方式

比如一个Frame当容器,有一个TextLabel和ImageLabel作为子节点

我们十分不推荐你仅仅为了管理子节点而继承GuiNode

docs.title: 核心概念
docs.text: 本章节将会介绍本库的几个核心概念

docs.title: 基础
docs.text:
本库会频繁出现realXxx与xxx(xxx为字段名),realXxx一般来说才是真正传给GuiRender渲染器的值,并且是相对于整个窗口的绝对值,xxx是用户的输入值,realXxx为了性能一般均为标量

本库完全不使用窗口大小,文档提到的窗口大小均为FrameBuffer大小

docs.title: 继承链
docs.text:
ParentNode(sealed)
    -NodeRoot(final)
    -GuiNode(non-sealed)
        -Frame
        -ScrollFrame
        -TextNode
            -TextLabel
            -TextBox
            -TextButton
            ...
        -ImageNode
            -ImageLabel
            -ImageButton
            ...
        -LayoutBox
            -VerticalBox
            -HorizontalBox
            ...
        ...

ParentNode拥有这些重要的protected字段:

int realPositionX

int realPositionY

int realPositionMaxX

int realPositionMaxY

int realSizeX

int realSizeY

float realAngle

上列7个值除了realAngle单位为角度外均为像素,且计算时结果会取整

NodeRoot会把realPositionX realPositionY realAngle置零, 把realSizeX realSizeY realPositionMaxX realPositionMaxY 设置为窗口大小

GuiNode会在初始化,父项要求重算,改变父项或者更改position/size/angle的时候重新算这7个值,并且自己算完后递归子项让它们重算

它们都拥有自引用泛型,且不是builder,所有setter返回self字段,self定义为(T) this,因此你可以在任何时候链式调用它

docs.title: ScaleOffset
docs.text:
ScaleOffset是本库重要性较高的类.它是一个不可变记录类,几乎所有节点的构造函数都要求ScaleOffset类型的position和size,定义为:

public record ScaleOffset(double xScale, int xOffset, double yScale, int yOffset) {...}

节点的位置和大小的类型都是它

构造方式有3种:

new ScaleOffset(xScale, xOffset, yScale, yOffset)

ScaleOffset.fromScale(xScale, yScale)

ScaleOffset.fromOffset(xOffset, yOffset)

以及一个固定的常量ZERO

一个节点的最终大小由他的字段决定,算法大致为:

parent.realSize * Scale + Offset

一个节点的最终位置也是由他的字段决定,算法大致为:

parent.realPosition + parent.realSize * Scale + Offset (注意:最终位置还有额外的Anchor影响,请见下文)

(注意:NodeRoot的最终大小即为窗口大小,坐标原点和realPosition位于0,0)

所有GuiNode子项都有这些public方法:

setPosition(ScaleOffset position)

setSize(ScaleOffset size)

ScaleOffset有许多方法,比如

with系列: withX withY withScale withOffset withXScale withXOffset ...

add系列: addScale addOffset addX addY addXScale addXOffset ...

docs.title: Anchor
docs.text:
一个节点拥有Anchor属性,它会影响节点的最终坐标

它不是记录类,而是由两个double值组成:xAnchor, yAnchor

它一般由2个0-1的分量组成,超出该范围也是合法的,但是可能会造成非预期行为,例如渲染到了窗口之外

假设已经按照上文中的公式算出了x和y,那么realPositionX和realPositionY则是:

x - this.realSizeX * xAnchor -> realPositionX

y - this.realSizeY * yAnchor -> realPositionY

所有GuiNode的子项都有这些public方法

setAnchor(double xAnchor, double yAnchor)

setXAnchor(double xAnchor)

setYAnchor(double yAnchor)

以及这些protected字段 double xAnchor double yAnchor

例如:

node.setAnchor(0, 0); //位于图形左上角
node.setAnchor(0.5, 0.5); //位于图形中心
node.setAnchor(1, 1); //位于图形右下角

docs.title: Angle与RealAngle
docs.text:
它们控制节点渲染时候的顺时针角度

旋转中心实际为图形的中心而非Anchor所在点

如果你直接调用了GuiRender绘制三角形的方法,那里的旋转中心是三角形重心

realAngle是通过自己的angle+父项的realAngle算出来的

所有GuiNode的子项都有setAngle(float angle)方法

例如:

node.setAngle(90f); //顺时针旋转90度

docs.title: RGBA
docs.text:
RGBA是一个不可变记录类,定义为:

public record RGBA(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha) {...}

注意:这四个值的范围必须全部是0-255

Alpha大致等于不透明度,值为0则完全透明,值为255则完全不透明,只是范围从0-1换成了0-255

它代表一种颜色 API几乎全部用他表示一个颜色,例如GuiNode的backgroundColor 它有withRed,withGreen,withBlue,withAlpha这四个方法

构造方式有1种:

new RGBA(red, green, blue, alpha)

或者使用RGBA类定义的常量: WHITE BLACK RED GREEN BLUE GRAY TRANSPARENT

示例:设置某node的背景色为不透明橙色

node.background().setColor(new RGBA(255, 128, 0, 255));

docs.title: 接下来...
docs.text:
现在,你已经明白我们库的基本用法了,如果你能看懂这个最终示例在做什么,那么恭喜你成功会使用我们的库了!接下来你可以开始使用这个库或者查看高级部分

public class Main {
    private static final AtomicBoolean shouldClose = new AtomicBoolean(false);

    private static long createWindow(int width, int height, String title, Window shared) {
        return glfwCreateWindow(width, height, title, MemoryUtil.NULL, shared == null ? MemoryUtil.NULL : shared.getWindowHandle());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
        if (!glfwInit()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Unable to initialize GLFW");
        }

        long windowHandle1 = createWindow(800, 600, "Test1", null);
        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle1);
        GL.createCapabilities();
        glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
        Window window1 = Window.from(windowHandle1);
        window1.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
        NodeRoot root1 = window1.getNodeRoot();
        ResourceManager resourceManager1 = root1.getResourceManager();

        long windowHandle2 = createWindow(800, 600, "Test2", window1);
        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle2);
        glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
        Window window2 = Window.from(windowHandle2);
        window2.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
        NodeRoot root2 = window2.getNodeRoot();
        ResourceManager resourceManager2 = root2.getResourceManager();

        Texture oiiacatBlue = resourceManager1.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-blue.jpg");
        Texture oiiacatRed = resourceManager1.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-red.jpg");
        Texture oiiacatGreen =  resourceManager1.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-green.jpg");

        ImageButton button = new ImageButton(oiiacatBlue, ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
                .normal().setImageAlignment(ImageAlignment.FILL).getNode()
                .onHover().setTexture(oiiacatRed).getNode()

                .setAnchor(0.5, 0.5)
                .setAngle(20)

                .setCornerRadius(10)
                .getNode();
        Frame blurBox = new Frame(ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.3, 0.3))
                .setAnchor(0.5, 0.5)

        CustomTweenFunction tweenFunction = new CustomTweenFunction(TweenFunctions.LINEAR)
                .setNestedSegment(0, 0.2, TweenFunctions.BOUNCE_IN_OUT, child1 -> {
                    child1.setNestedSegment(0, 0.8, TweenFunctions.QUINT_IN_OUT, childChild1 -> {

                                });
                            })

                })

                .setNestedSegment(0.5, 0.7, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, child3 -> {

        ScaleOffsetTween scaleOffsetTween = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.ZERO, ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), 1000, tweenFunction, false);
        ScaleOffsetTween scaleOffsetTween1 = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), ScaleOffset.ZERO, 1000, tweenFunction, false);
        scaleOffsetTween.onComplete(scaleOffsetTween1::play);

        HorizontalBox box = new HorizontalBox(ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))

        Frame frame = new Frame(ScaleOffset.fromScale(0, 0), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5));

    private static Window runOtherWindowInOtherThread(int width, int height, String title) throws InterruptedException {
        long handle = createWindow(width, height, title, null);
        Window window = Window.from(handle);
        CountDownLatch initLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
        Thread thread = new Thread(() -> {
            glfwMakeContextCurrent(handle);
            GL.createCapabilities();
            window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
            initLatch.countDown();
            NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

            TextLabel label = new TextLabel("Hello from other thread!", ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5));
            TextBox box = new TextBox(ScaleOffset.fromScale(0, 0), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)).setZIndex(100);

            ScaleOffsetTween tween1 = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.ZERO, ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), 10000L, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, false);
            ScaleOffsetTween tween2 = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), ScaleOffset.ZERO, 10000L, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, false);

            tween1.bindSetter(label::setPosition);
            tween2.bindSetter(label::setPosition);

            tween1.onComplete(tween2::play);
            tween2.onComplete(tween1::play);

            root.addChildren(label, box);

            root.getTweenScheduler().registerTweens(tween1, tween2);

            tween1.play();

            glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);

            while (!shouldClose.get()) {
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) {
                    root.runAllTasksOnCurrentThread();
                }
                glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
                root.render();
                glfwSwapBuffers(handle);
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) {
                    break;
                }
            }
            shouldClose.set(true);
        });
        thread.start();
        initLatch.await();
        return window;
    }
}

docs.title: 多窗口
docs.text: 本章节将会讲解如何在本库使用多窗口

docs.title: 基础
docs.text:
使用多窗口时,你应该有一个主循环,无论你有多少个线程,同一时刻只能有一个主循环

主循环应该是当前这几个线程中唯一会调用glfwPollEvents的循环

docs.title: 多窗口下的单个窗口的渲染
docs.text: 当你渲染某窗口时,你应该至少确保ContextCurrent为当前窗口,你可以使用glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle)来更新

docs.title: 单线程多窗口
docs.text:
当你单线程渲染多个窗口时,你应该做到切换上下文,并且最好拥有一个主窗口,与子窗口共享资源(glfwCreateWindow的share参数),如果不共享资源那么Texture和Font无法共用

例如(假设一个窗口关闭另外一个也要关闭):

private static long createWindow(int width, int height, String title, Window shared) {
    return glfwCreateWindow(width, height, title, MemoryUtil.NULL, shared == null ? MemoryUtil.NULL : shared.getWindowHandle());
}

public static void main(String[] args) {
    if (!glfwInit()) {
        throw new RuntimeException("Unable to initialize GLFW");
    }

    long windowHandle1 = createWindow(800, 600, "Test1", null);
    glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle1);
    GL.createCapabilities();
    glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
    Window window1 = Window.from(windowHandle1);
    window1.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
    NodeRoot root1 = window1.getNodeRoot();
    ResourceManager resourceManager1 = root1.getResourceManager();

    long windowHandle2 = createWindow(800, 600, "Test2", window1);
    glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle2);
    glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
    Window window2 = Window.from(windowHandle2);
    window2.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
    NodeRoot root2 = window2.getNodeRoot();
    ResourceManager resourceManager2 = root2.getResourceManager();

    Texture oiiacatBlue = resourceManager1.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-blue.jpg"); //两个窗口都可以访问

    while (!glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle1) && !glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle2)) {
        glfwPollEvents();

        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle1);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
        root1.render();
        glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle1);

        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle2);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
        root2.render();
        glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle2);
    }

    window1.close();
    window2.close();

    glfwTerminate();
}

Warn

如果你开了垂直同步,那么上述代码的glfwSwapBuffers每一个都会阻塞一个垂直同步周期,假设你显示器最大帧率120,那么实际最大帧率其实是60

docs.title: 多线程多窗口
docs.text:
当你多线程多窗口的时候,不要share任何资源,这很重要

你应该至少有一个主窗口(主线程),只有他调用glfwPollEvents,且glfwCreateWindow与Window.from的调用都应该由他负责,window.init才是那个窗口的渲染线程负责

多线程多窗口示例(假设一个窗口关闭另外一个也要关闭):

public class Main {
    private static final AtomicBoolean shouldClose = new AtomicBoolean(false);

    private static long createWindow(int width, int height, String title, Window shared) {
        return glfwCreateWindow(width, height, title, MemoryUtil.NULL, shared == null ? MemoryUtil.NULL : shared.getWindowHandle());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (!glfwInit()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Unable to initialize GLFW");
        }

        long windowHandle = createWindow(800, 600, "Main Thread", null);
        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle);
        GL.createCapabilities();
        glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
        Window window = Window.from(windowHandle);
        window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
        NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

        Window otherWindow = runOtherWindowInOtherThread(800, 600, "Other Thread");
        Thread thread = otherWindow.getRenderThread();

        while (!shouldClose.get() && !glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle)) {
            glfwPollEvents();

            glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
            root.render();
            glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle);
        }

        shouldClose.set(true);

        thread.join();

        window.close();
        otherWindow.close();

        glfwTerminate();
    }

    private static Window runOtherWindowInOtherThread(int width, int height, String title) throws InterruptedException {
        long handle = createWindow(width, height, title, null);
        Window window = Window.from(handle);
        CountDownLatch initLatch = new CountDownLatch(1); //生产环境不要这么写
        Thread thread = new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                glfwMakeContextCurrent(handle);
                GL.createCapabilities();
                window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
            } finally {
                initLatch.countDown();
            }
            NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

            glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);

            while (!shouldClose.get()) {
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) {
                    root.runAllTasksOnCurrentThread(); //为了确保正确分发UserRequestWindowCloseEvent
                }
                glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
                root.render();
                glfwSwapBuffers(handle);
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) { //如果在开头用户请求关闭窗口,节点分发后被取消,那么if块不会进入
                    break;
                }
            }
            shouldClose.set(true);
        });
        thread.start();
        initLatch.await();
        return window;
    }
}

docs.title: 节点外观
docs.text: 本章节将会讲解每个GuiNode都会有的共用属性.

docs.title: ClipChildren
docs.text:
类型:boolean

默认值:false

启用后将会限制所有子项只能渲染在父项的边框内.ClipChildren会考虑节点的圆角值,且会跟随节点的角度旋转区域

启用后命中测试也会考虑父链上的该因素,换句话说只要玩家鼠标没有真正放到节点可见的地方那么命中测试就会返回false

示例:

node.setClipChildren(true);

docs.title: DrawBackground
docs.text:
类型:boolean

默认值:不定,某些节点true,有些false

大部分节点都有这个属性,如果有这个属性那么该节点就必定有对应setter

一般拥有该属性的节点都会实现HasDrawBackground接口

如果该值为false,整个背景将不会渲染

如果你没看到背景,且节点有drawBackground属性,优先考虑将它设为true

docs.title: ZIndex
docs.text:
类型:int

默认值:0

顾名思义,他决定节点渲染/事件分发在同一父项下分发的顺序,数字越大,渲染越靠上,事件越先收到

示例:把node的ZIndex设置为100

node.setZIndex(100);

docs.title: Background
docs.text:
background是每个节点都会有的字段,但是如果子类未暴露出绘制背景的能力则设置他无效 背景配置项通过GuiNode基类的background()方法访问,你可以通过背景配置项的getNode()方法来回到节点

示例:配置背景

Frame frame = new Frame(ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
                .background()
                .setColor(new RGBA(210, 230, 255, 90))
                .setCornerRadius(10)
                .getNode();

docs.title: BackgroundBlurStrength
docs.text:
类型:double

默认值:0

范围:推荐0.1-1 实际值将会在渲染器侧钳制到0-2

启用后将会对背景所有像素应用高斯模糊,会跟随节点的角度旋转区域

如果Alpha=255,无论设置值为多少都将没有任何效果,因为不透明节点,本来也是直接覆盖,模糊后面的像素无意义

示例:

background.setBlurStrength(0.7);

docs.title: BackgroundColor
docs.text:
类型:RGBA

默认值:RGBA.WHITE

背景的颜色

示例:

background.setColor(new RGBA(210, 230, 255, 90));

docs.title: BackgroundBorder
docs.text:
BackgroundBorder属性实际由6个类型不同的独立分量组成

类型为int的: leftBorderThickness rightBorderThickness topBorderThickness bottomBorderThickness

(以上这四个值必须>=0否则会出现非预期行为,默认值都是0,单位为像素)

(如果你不想一个个调用这四个的setter,可以使用setBorderThickness(int thickness)一键设置四个)

类型为RGBA的:

borderColor

(默认值为RGBA.BLACK)

类型为ThicknessPosition的:

borderThicknessPosition

(默认值为OUTSIDE)

类型为int的4个分别对应背景四条边的边框厚度,类型为RGBA的决定边框的颜色,类型为ThicknessPosition的决定边框在哪

ThicknessPosition有三个值:

OUTSIDE(渲染在背景外)

INSIDE(渲染在背景内)

CENTER(渲染在背景的边框中心)

以上的值都是边框因此即使节点旋转它也会紧贴背景

示例:设置一个大小为5像素的蓝色边框,渲染在背景内,使用链式API

background.setBorderThickness(5)
    .setBorderColor(RGBA.BLUE)
    .setBorderThicknessPosition(ThicknessPosition.INSIDE);

docs.title: BackgroundCornerRadius
docs.text:
它由4个类型为int的独立分量组成

leftTopCornerRadius rightTopCornerRadius leftBottomCornerRadius rightBottomCornerRadius

(它们必须>=0否则会出现非预期行为,默认值都是0,单位是像素圆角半径)

(如果你不想一个个调用setter,可以使用setCornerRadius(int radius)一键设置四个)

示例:设置左上角圆角半径为5,右下角为20,右上角为30,左下角为0,使用链式API

background.setLeftTopCornerRadius(5)
    .setRightTopCornerRadius(30)
    .setLeftBottomCornerRadius(0)
    .setRightBottomCornerRadius(20);

docs.title: 节点树
docs.text: 本章节将会讲解库内部的节点树模型

docs.title: ParentNode
docs.text: 所有节点,包括根节点都直接或间接继承ParentNode.它持有children列表.因此所有节点都可以有子项,叶子节点仅仅是没有子项的节点

docs.title: GuiNode
docs.text: GuiNode继承ParentNode,因此也有children列表.它还拥有parent字段与root字段.

docs.title: NodeRoot
docs.text:
NodeRoot继承ParentNode,因此它也有children列表.与GuiNode不同,它作为节点根,没有parent,root就是他自己.

NodeRoot实例拥有runTask(Runnable task)方法,注册的任务将会在下次渲染前执行

docs.title: Children
docs.text:
当你调用了ParentNode的某个实例的addChild方法并传入了某node实例的时候,它会做这些事:

1.如果node已有父项:调用父项的removeChild方法,传入node

2.把node的parent设置为this

3.把node添加进children列表

4.按子项的zIndex升序(zIndex小的在前面,zIndex一样则按插入顺序)排序children列表

5.递归设置子项以及子项的root为this的root

6.让node重新计算自己的位置

7.分发init事件(各个节点自己判断有没有init过,如果init过了就不触发)

如果你翻看源码会发现ParentNode没有第5步的行为,但是它通过sealed的唯二子类都重写了这个方法递归设置root

ParentNode还有一个addChildren便捷重载,它使用变长参数(GuiNode...),遍历这个变长参数列表调用addChild

当你调用了ParentNode的某个实例的removeChild方法并传入了某node实例后,它只会做这些:

如果自己真的有这个子项,那么将node从children列表移除,node.parent字段置空

ParentNode还有一个removeChildren便捷重载,它也使用变长参数(GuiNode...),遍历这个变长参数列表调用removeChild

外部可以通过getChildren()拿到子节点列表(Collections.unmodifiableList包装的不可变视图)

docs.title: 各种事件在节点树上触发的顺序
docs.text:
渲染和通知性事件(比如窗口最大化最小化)按正序遍历children(父节点先处理,子节点再处理,目的:子节点渲染能直接画在父节点之上,且通知性事件父节点先处理可以让父节点先更新自己再更新子项)

鼠标点击,键盘输入等可取消事件按反序遍历children(子节点先处理,父节点再处理,目的:最上层节点能优先接收到鼠标事件,键盘事件等,否则用户点击鼠标是在最底层渲染的节点响应很反直觉)

Warn

zIndex只影响同一个父项下所有子节点的排序

所有GLFW事件都会使用runTask调度到渲染线程来处理

以下是一个演示用的节点树

root
    -Frame1(zIndex=0)
        -Frame11(zIndex=-10)
        -Frame12(zIndex=1)
    -Frame2(zIndex=1)
        -Frame21(zIndex=100)
        -Frame22(zIndex=101)

渲染顺序:

Frame1-Frame11-Frame12-Frame2-Frame21-Frame22

鼠标/键盘事件接受顺序(任意一个节点取消了事件会停止分发)

Frame22-Frame21-Frame2-Frame12-Frame11-Frame1

docs.title: 资源
docs.text: 本章将会讲解如何使用ResourceManager加载资源,以及资源对象如何使用.

docs.title: ResourceManager
docs.text:
所有资源的加载都应该通过ResourceManager.加载资源的调用应该在渲染线程使用(其他线程可以使用root.runTask调度到渲染线程),并且必须在window.init调用之后

你可以通过NodeRoot的getResourceManager方法获取ResourceManager实例.

ResourceManager定义了这些方法:

Texture loadTexture(String path);
Texture loadTexture(String path, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadTexture(byte[] data);
Texture loadTexture(byte[] data, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(String path, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(String path, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(byte[] data, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(byte[] data, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Font loadFont(String path);

docs.title: 加载字体
docs.text:
注意:他们都不会缓存,每次都会重新上传,返回新的Font

加载字体仅需通过loadFont(String path)即可获取Font实例

Font实例可以传给各种需要Font的节点,如TextLabel

textLabel.description().setFont(font);

Font是个不可变记录,定义为:

public record Font(FT_Face face, String path, ByteBuffer data, int id) {}

它拥有public int getStringWidth(String text, int fontSize)方法与public int getStringHeight(int fontSize)方法让你获取占用的像素

静态方法loadDefaultFont(GuiRender render)返回默认字体(当前版本为MiSans Regular)

docs.title: 加载贴图
docs.text:
加载贴图的核心方法是这些:

Texture loadTexture(String path, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadTexture(byte[] data, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(String path, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(byte[] data, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);

注意:他们都不会缓存,每次都会重新上传到GPU,返回新的Texture

第一个函数加载普通纹理,path表示本地纹理的路径(支持硬盘/jar内部),isLinear:像素风传false,高分辨率传true,便捷重载默认传true (isLinear=true使用线性过滤,缩放时平滑,false使用最近邻,缩放时保持像素锐利.所以像素画传false,普通图片传true)

第三个函数加载九宫格纹理,path表示本地纹理的路径(支持硬盘/jar内部),NiceSliceType有PROPORTIONAL FIXED_BORDER两种

PROPORTIONAL:四个角按目标宽度与原图宽度的比例缩放,跟随目标尺寸自然变化

FIXED_BORDER:四个角保持原始像素,只有中心和边被拉伸/平铺

stretchInner表示九宫格中心是平铺还是拉伸,isLinear同上,left,right,top,bottom表示九宫格的四个边离中心的对应边的像素距离

第四个函数对比第二个函数,第二个函数对比第一个函数仅仅是把纹理获取路径从资源管理器自己读字节改为了让你传字节

Texture是一个不可变记录,定义为:

public record Texture(boolean isNiceSlice, NiceSliceType sliceType, boolean stretchInner, int textureId, int width, int height, int channel, String filePath, int left, int right, int top, int bottom) {...}

如果它不是九宫格,sliceType将是null,stretchInner不定,left,right,top,bottom都是-1

如果从byte[]加载,filePath是null

示例:构造一个Button,占满全屏,在屏幕正中心,normal状态下贴图是oiiaioiiai-blue.jpg,且图片对齐为FILL,鼠标悬停状态下是oiiaioiiai-red.jpg,点击状态下是oiiaioiiai-green.jpg,会绘制Frame的默认背景,圆角半径为10像素

ResourceManager resourceManager = root.getResourceManager();

ImageButton button = new ImageButton(resourceManager.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-blue.jpg"), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(1.0, 1.0))
                .normal().setImageAlignment(ImageAlignment.FILL).getNode()
                .onHover().setTexture(resourceManager.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-red.jpg")).getNode()
                .onClick().setTexture(resourceManager.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-green.jpg")).getNode()
                .setAnchor(0.5, 0.5)
                .setDrawBackground(true)
                .background()
                .setCornerRadius(10)
                .getNode();

docs.title: 卸载资源
docs.text:
卸载资源的方法有这些:

void unloadTexture(Texture texture);
default void unloadTexture(Texture... textures) {
    for (Texture texture : textures) {
        unloadTexture(texture);
    }
}
void unloadFont(Font font);
default void unloadFont(Font... fonts) {
    for (Font font : fonts) {
        unloadFont(font);
    }
}

它们都会释放部分内存资源,另一部分根据底层渲染器实现不同,GPU资源根据底层渲染器实现不同也不一样

Warn

请在你加载资源的ResourceMangaer卸载资源,不要用别的窗口的ResourceMangaer卸载

docs.title: Tween
docs.text: 本章节将会讲解库内的Tween(补间动画)的使用方式

docs.title: 核心概念
docs.text:
所有Tween本质不绑定任何UI,它本质只是一个根据时间增长的值,你可以将它用在任何地方

Tween由Tween对象(数据和部分操作的载体)与TweenFunction(缓动函数,决定如何随着时间变化)两部分组成

docs.title: Tween调度器
docs.text:
Tween调度器是一个调度一堆Tween的载体.在我们的库中,NodeRoot就有一个Tween调度器,你可以通过getTweenScheduler来获取

调度器每次被调用step()方法的时候都会调用注册的每个Tween的step(delta),Tween只有被step才会推进值

你可以通过以下几个方法来注册/取消注册Tween到调度器

public void registerTween(Tween tween) {...}
public void registerTweens(Tween... tweens) {...}
public void unregisterTween(Tween tween) {...}
public void unregisterTweens(Tween... tweens) {...}

Warning

NodeRoot在渲染时会自动步进它自己的Tween调度器,你不需要手动步进

docs.title: Tween对象
docs.text:
Tween对象是承载数据的载体,它跟随时间增长自己的值.目前库内拥有DoubleTween FloatTween IntTween三种基本类型的Tween对象 与ScaleOffsetTween RGBATween 两种复合类型的Tween对象

一个Tween对象应有能返回自己值的方法,如上列五种对象的getCurrentValue方法

Tween基类拥有pause(), resume(), reset(), play()等方法

pause:暂停Tween

resume:恢复Tween

reset:重置Tween播放进度

play:调用reset()和resume()

你可以调用setAlwaysRepeat设置是否永久重复播放,调用setRemainingRepeatCount设置重复几次Tween(不含首次)

Warning

Tween对象的时间单位是毫秒 一个Tween new出来不会自动play(),你需要手动调用

示例:DoubleTween的绑定Setter的方法(bindSetter)

    public double getCurrentValue() {
        return currentValue;
    }

    public void bindSetter(DoubleConsumer consumer) {
        onUpdate(() -> consumer.accept(currentValue));
    }

所有Tween对象的构造函数最后一个参数一般决定它在播放完后是否被Tween调度器自动移除

示例:创建一个ScaleOffsetTween,使用5秒时间从Scale坐标(0, 0)平滑移到(1, 1),并让某node的position应用它,播放完成后自动被调度器移除

ScaleOffsetTween scaleOffsetTween = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.ZERO, ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), 5000L, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, true);

scaleOffsetTween.bindSetter(node::setPosition);
//如果还没注册到调度器的话
nodeRoot.getTweenScheduler().registerTween(scaleOffsetTween);

scaleOffsetTween.play();

示例:永久重复播放某tween

tween.setAlwaysRepeat(true);

docs.title: 缓动函数(TweenFunction)
docs.text:
TweenFunction是缓动函数,它决定进度(范围0-1)在某处的时侯输出的值(比例)是多少

TweenFunction在我们的库中还是一个函数式接口,定义为:

@FunctionalInterface
public interface TweenFunction {
    double computeEased(double percent);
}

其中,percent恒为0-1,代表当前Tween百分比进度,返回值代表映射后的进度,一般是0-1,比如Linear直接返回percent表示不做改变,QUAD_IN先做一次平方再返回,你也可以超过/低于这个值以做高级效果(如Back,冲过再返回)

docs.title: 内置缓动函数库(TweenFunctions)
docs.text:
TweenFunctions是我们的预制补间动画库,它拥有三十多种类型,你可以自由使用,自由搭配

所有类型 组 常量 效果 Linear LINEAR 匀速 Sine SINE_IN 正弦加速进入 Sine SINE_OUT 正弦减速退出 Sine SINE_IN_OUT 正弦两端缓入缓出 Quad QUAD_IN 二次加速进入 Quad QUAD_OUT 二次减速退出 Quad QUAD_IN_OUT 二次两端缓入缓出 Cubic CUBIC_IN 三次加速进入 Cubic CUBIC_OUT 三次减速退出 Cubic CUBIC_IN_OUT 三次两端缓入缓出 Quart QUART_IN 四次加速进入 Quart QUART_OUT 四次减速退出 Quart QUART_IN_OUT 四次两端缓入缓出 Quint QUINT_IN 五次加速进入 Quint QUINT_OUT 五次减速退出 Quint QUINT_IN_OUT 五次两端缓入缓出 Expo EXPO_IN 指数加速进入 Expo EXPO_OUT 指数减速退出 Expo EXPO_IN_OUT 指数两端缓入缓出 Circ CIRC_IN 圆形加速进入 Circ CIRC_OUT 圆形减速退出 Circ CIRC_IN_OUT 圆形两端缓入缓出 Back BACK_IN 起步先往回拉一下再前进 Back BACK_OUT 到达时冲过头再退回 Back BACK_IN_OUT 两端都有回拉 Elastic ELASTIC_IN 弹性震荡进入 Elastic ELASTIC_OUT 弹性震荡退出 Elastic ELASTIC_IN_OUT 弹性震荡两端 Bounce BOUNCE_IN 弹跳进入 Bounce BOUNCE_OUT 弹跳退出 Bounce BOUNCE_IN_OUT 弹跳两端 Other SMOOTHSTEP 平滑阶跃 Other SMOOTHERSTEP 更平滑的阶跃 后缀 含义 _IN 慢启动 _OUT 慢结束 _IN_OUT 两端都慢

docs.title: CustomTweenFunction
docs.text:
CustomTweenFunction是TweenFunction中重要的类.它实现了TweenFunction接口,因此它可以传给任何需要TweenFunction的地方

它有两个构造函数:

    public CustomTweenFunction() {
        this(TweenFunctions.LINEAR);
    }
    public CustomTweenFunction(TweenFunction outOfRangeFunction) {
        setOutOfRangeFunction(outOfRangeFunction);
    }

构造参数TweenFunction代表如果某个要用的区间没有被注册所调用的函数

它有三个核心方法:

    public CustomTweenFunction setSegment(double start, double end, TweenFunction function) {
        tweenFunctions.put(start, end, function);
        return this;
    }

    public CustomTweenFunction setNestedSegment(double start, double end, Consumer<CustomTweenFunction> function) {
        return setNestedSegment(start, end, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, function);
    }

    public CustomTweenFunction setNestedSegment(double start, double end, TweenFunction nestedOutOfRangeFunction, Consumer<CustomTweenFunction> nestedConfigurator) {
        CustomTweenFunction function = new CustomTweenFunction(nestedOutOfRangeFunction);
        setSegment(start, end, function);
        nestedConfigurator.accept(function);
        return this;
    }

Warning

上面的start,end必须在0-1之内,否则可能永远不会被调用

其中,第一个方法setSegment的参数有:该区间开始值,该区间结束值,该区间使用什么缓动函数,返回this方便链式调用

第三个方法setNestedSegment会新建一个嵌套的CustomTweenFunction存入自己,参数有:该区间开始值,该区间结束值,新的CustomTweenFunction某个要用的区间没有被注册所调用的函数,新的CustomTweenFunction的配置函数(你可以在那上面继续调用该三个方法,实现嵌套),返回this方便链式调用

第二个方法是第三个方法的便捷重载,新的CustomTweenFunction某个要用的区间没有被注册所调用的函数恒为LINEAR

示例1:构造一个前半段LINEAR,后半段QUAD_IN的缓动函数

CustomTweenFunction tweenFunction1 = new CustomTweenFunction()
                .setSegment(0, 0.5, TweenFunctions.LINEAR)
                .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.QUAD_IN);

示例2:将示例1的tweenFunction1注册到另外一个CustomFunction的前半段,后半段使用CUBIC_IN

CustomTweenFunction tweenFunction2 = new CustomTweenFunction()
                .setSegment(0, 0.5, tweenFunction1)
                .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.CUBIC_IN);

示例2的预期效果为:0-0.5进入tweenFunction1,0-0.25(tweenFunction1的0-0.5)进入LINEAR,0.25-0.5(tweenFunction1的0.5-1)进入QUAD_IN,0.5-1进入CUBIC_IN

示例3:将示例1和示例2最终组合的TweenFunction改成链式调用直接构造

CustomTweenFunction tweenFunction3 = new CustomTweenFunction()
        .setNestedSegment(0, 0.5, function -> function
                .setSegment(0, 0.5, TweenFunctions.LINEAR)
                .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.QUAD_IN))
        .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.CUBIC_IN);

docs.title: NumberTween
docs.text:
NumberTween是一个抽象类,基本类型的Tween类一般直接继承他.它会帮你管理目标时间,缓动函数等,子类仅需管理自己的值并且通过重写applyEased(double eased)函数来更新自己的值(一般来说你只需要startValue + (endValue - startValue) * eased),通过重写resetTween来重置自己的值,并且提供getCurrentValue方法与bindSetter方法

Warning

你一般需要在applyEased方法中,值更新的时候调用父类的triggerOnUpdateCallback方法,否则注册的更新回调不会触发

示例:IntTween类

public class IntTween extends NumberTween {
    private final int startValue;
    private final int endValue;
    private int currentValue;

    @Override
    protected void resetTween() {
        currentValue = startValue;
    }

    public IntTween(int startValue, int endValue, long time, TweenFunction function, boolean removeOnComplete) {
        super(time, function, removeOnComplete);
        this.startValue = startValue;
        this.currentValue = startValue;
        this.endValue = endValue;
    }

    @Override
    protected void applyEased(double eased) {
        currentValue = Maths.round(startValue + (endValue - startValue) * eased);
        triggerOnUpdateCallback();
    }

    public void bindSetter(IntConsumer consumer) {
        onUpdate(() -> consumer.accept(currentValue));
    }

    public int getCurrentValue() {
        return currentValue;
    }
}

docs.title: CompositeTween
docs.text:
CompositeTween,复合类型的Tween类一般直接继承他,它会帮你管理子项,更新回调,管理绑定的setter等,子类一般仅需把自己的子Tween对象注册给父类(使用父类的addChildren或addChild方法),提供getCurrentValue方法,将父类的泛型参数填为Tween的值的类型

示例:ScaleOffsetTween类

public class ScaleOffsetTween extends CompositeTween<ScaleOffset> {
    private final DoubleTween xScaleTween;
    private final IntTween xOffsetTween;
    private final DoubleTween yScaleTween;
    private final IntTween yOffsetTween;

    public ScaleOffset getCurrentValue() {
        return new ScaleOffset(xScaleTween.getCurrentValue(), xOffsetTween.getCurrentValue(), yScaleTween.getCurrentValue(), yOffsetTween.getCurrentValue());
    }

    public ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset start, ScaleOffset end, long time, TweenFunction function, boolean removeOnComplete) {
        super(removeOnComplete);
        xScaleTween = new DoubleTween(start.xScale(), end.xScale(), time, function, false);
        xOffsetTween = new IntTween(start.xOffset(), end.xOffset(), time, function, false);
        yScaleTween = new DoubleTween(start.yScale(), end.yScale(), time, function, false);
        yOffsetTween = new IntTween(start.yOffset(), end.yOffset(), time, function, false);

        addChildren(xScaleTween, xOffsetTween, yScaleTween, yOffsetTween);
    }
}

docs.title: 首次使用
docs.text:
本章节将会演示初始化库,嵌入渲染循环并且在屏幕上显示一个全屏的白色矩形

本UI库没有自己的渲染循环, 它通常直接嵌入宿主程序中.

当你创建了一个窗口并持有窗口句柄的时候,你可以这么做以初始化库:

Window window = Window.from(windowHandle); //将会注册GLFW回调
window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL); //将会初始化渲染后端

Warning

你应该在glfwPollEvent的线程调用Window.from,在渲染线程调用window.init

并且不要在Window.from之后注册任何GLFW回调, 你的回调应该在Window.from之前注册

初始化Window后,你可以获取GUI节点根:

NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

然后,你可以在你的渲染循环里:

//在渲染UI之前的代码...
root.render();
//在渲染UI之后的代码,例如glfwSwapBuffers()...

这样,UI库就可以正常执行渲染了

现在,我们将在屏幕上渲染一个覆盖全屏的长方形:

ScaleOffset position = ScaleOffset.ZERO; //位置在左上角
ScaleOffset size = ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1); //占满父节点,这里父节点是NodeRoot,占满父节点就是占满全屏
Frame frame = new Frame(position, size); //新建Frame对象
root.addChild(frame); //将Frame挂到节点根

ScaleOffset可以在核心概念章节查看详细用法

Warning

上列代码不要在渲染循环中每次都新建,因为我们是保留模式UI库,这会导致每帧都有一个新Frame挂到节点树上,性能严重降低

如果没有任何问题的话,你应该在屏幕上看到一个覆盖全屏的白色长方形

docs.title: Custom Nodes
docs.text:
Custom nodes are suitable for drawing that built-in nodes cannot express. If you can compose existing nodes to achieve it, do not create a custom node.

This chapter will introduce how to inherit from GuiNode, how to call GuiRender methods, and how to respond to events. Which scenarios are worth customizing depends on your project. If a requirement is common enough, the library will provide a built-in node.

docs.title: How to Make One
docs.text:
Your custom node should inherit from the GuiNode<?> abstract class, and the generic parameter should be your own type, e.g. Frame extends GuiNode<Frame>.

If you ultimately decide to make your own custom node, then you must directly call our rendering abstraction layer.

After your class inherits GuiNode, it must override the render(GuiRender render, double delta) method, where delta is in milliseconds. In the current version, we do not recommend using delta for animation; we recommend using Tween instead. Tween is introduced in the previous chapter.

Your constructor should at least have ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size and call super(position, size).

All your setter methods should return this. If you are making an abstract class, please define it as: Example<T extends Example<T>> extends GuiNode<T> and have all setters return T (using the parent class field self).

If you want to draw the default background, please call the render method of the parent class field background. If your background drawing is optional, please add a drawBackground property (field, setter, and getter) and implement the HasDrawBackground interface, filling the generic with your own type. The default value is freely determined by the node type.

Example: The simplest Frame class that only calls the render method of the parent class background field

public class Frame extends GuiNode<Frame> {
    @Override
    protected void render(GuiRender render, double delta) {
        background.render(render);
    }

    public Frame(ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size) {
        super(position, size);
    }
}

Example: A DemoFrame class with optional background drawing

public class DemoFrame extends GuiNode<DemoFrame> implements HasDrawBackground<DemoFrame> {
    private boolean drawBackground = false;

    @Override
    public DemoFrame setDrawBackground(boolean drawBackground) {
        this.drawBackground = drawBackground;
        return self;
    }
    @Override
    public boolean isDrawBackground() {
        return drawBackground;
    }

    @Override
    protected void render(GuiRender render, double delta) {
        if (drawBackground) {
            background.render(render);
        }
    }

    public DemoFrame(ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size) {
        super(position, size);
    }
}

docs.title: Events
docs.text:
Your node can listen to any events you want.

onXxx are hooks for your custom node to override. dispatchXxx (including dispatchRender) is the dispatch flow and generally does not need to be overridden.

If you only want to determine whether the mouse is inside the node, it is recommended to use the parent class field protected boolean mouseInNode.

The parent class also maintains for you which mouse buttons are currently clicking the node: protected Set<MouseButton> currentMouseClickButtons. If you want to cancel events, you can choose to override.

Example: A certain Button's onMouseButtonEvent method

@Override
    protected void onMouseButtonEvent(MouseButtonEvent event) {
        if (!Collections.disjoint(canTriggerMouseButtons, currentMouseClickButtons)) { // canTriggerMouseButtons is the node's own field
            event.cancel();
            mouseButtonEventListenerRegistry.trigger(self, event); // self is a field inherited from ParentNode, of type T
        }
    }

Currently, the following methods can be overridden. After overriding, simply write any subsequent processing you want in the method body.

// Cancelable events (event.cancel() is available; calling it prevents subsequent dispatch)
protected void onKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseButtonEvent(MouseButtonEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseMoveEvent(MouseMoveEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseEnterWindowEvent(MouseEnterWindowEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseLeaveWindowEvent(MouseLeaveWindowEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseScrollEvent(MouseScrollEvent event) {}
protected void onUserInputTextEvent(UserInputTextEvent event) {}
protected void onUserRequestWindowCloseEvent(UserRequestWindowCloseEvent event) {} // If canceled, it not only prevents event dispatch but also prevents the window from closing
protected void onUserDropFilesEvent(UserDropFilesEvent event) {}

// Non-cancelable events
protected void onWindowMinimizeEvent(WindowMinimizeEvent event) {}
protected void onWindowMaximizeEvent(WindowMaximizeEvent event) {}
protected void onWindowMoveEvent(WindowMoveEvent event) {}
protected void onWindowCloseEvent(WindowCloseEvent event) {}
protected void onWindowFocusChangeEvent(WindowFocusChangeEvent event) {}
protected void onFrameBufferSizeChangeEvent(FrameBufferSizeChangeEvent event) {}
protected void onPreeditEvent(PreeditEvent event) {} // IME preedit event
protected void onRelayout() {} // Called when layout needs to be recalculated
protected void onWindowFocusNodeChangeEvent(ParentNode<?> oldFocusNode, ParentNode<?> newFocusNode) {}
protected void tick() {} // Fixed 60 times per second; if the frame rate is below 60, it will catch up at the beginning of each render
protected void init(GuiRender render) {} // Triggered when the node first joins the node tree; at this point parent and root will absolutely not be null, and this event will not be triggered a second time

Warning

Some parent nodes such as TextNode, ImageNode, and LayoutBox override onRelayout themselves, so please call super.onRelayout() once.

docs.title: Intermediate Layer Node Parent Classes
docs.text: This chapter will explain several intermediate-layer abstract classes for nodes. They provide convenient APIs/classes in certain aspects for you to use.

docs.title: ImageNode
docs.text:
ImageNode is the abstract base class for image nodes and inherits from GuiNode. It internally defines public class ImageRenderDescription (non-static). This type holds all the data needed to render an image. All its methods return the object itself, and it has a getNode method that returns the outer class.

If the node you want to make has an image, you can inherit from ImageNode.

If you want to render an ImageRenderDescription, call render(GuiRender render).

If your node has multiple images to manage, you can design your API like these three methods of ImageButton: normal, onHover, and onClick, returning the ImageRenderDescription corresponding to that state.

public ImageRenderDescription normal() {
    return normal;
}
public ImageRenderDescription onHover() {
    return onHover;
}
public ImageRenderDescription onClick() {
    return onClick;
}

Info

Because ImageRenderDescription's getNode() method directly returns the outer class, you only need to provide methods that return ImageRenderDescription.

Example: The ImageLabel class, which uses ImageRenderDescription and inherits from ImageNode

public class ImageLabel extends ImageNode<ImageLabel> implements HasDrawBackground<ImageLabel> {
    private final ImageRenderDescription imageRenderDescription;
    private boolean drawBackground = true;

    @Override
    public void render(GuiRender render, double delta) {
        if (drawBackground) background.render(render);
        imageRenderDescription.render(render);
    }

    @Override
    public ImageLabel setDrawBackground(boolean drawBackground) {
        this.drawBackground = drawBackground;
        return this;
    }
    @Override
    public boolean isDrawBackground() {
        return drawBackground;
    }

    public ImageRenderDescription getImageRenderDescription() {
        return imageRenderDescription;
    }

    @Override
    public void onRelayout() {
        operationImageAlignment();
    }

    private void operationImageAlignment() {
        imageRenderDescription.operationImageAlignment();
    }

    public ImageLabel(Texture texture, ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size) {
        super(position, size);
        this.imageRenderDescription = new ImageRenderDescription().setTexture(texture);
    }
}

docs.title: TextNode
docs.text:
TextNode is the abstract base class for text nodes and inherits from GuiNode. It internally defines:

public abstract class AbstractTextRenderDescription

public class TextRenderDescription

public class CanWrappedTextRenderDescription

AbstractTextRenderDescription is a non-static abstract base class that holds all the data needed for text rendering, such as the font and the alignment used relative to the node.

TextRenderDescription only inherits from AbstractTextRenderDescription, fills the generic with TextRenderDescription, and adds no extra behavior.

CanWrappedTextRenderDescription adds the wrap field and the setWrap and isWrap methods, used to control automatic line wrapping.

If the node you want to make needs to render text, you can inherit from TextNode.

Warning

CanWrappedTextRenderDescription automatically wraps lines based on \n and the node width and the width of each character, while TextRenderDescription does not wrap even when it encounters \n, and it will be rendered as notdef.

If you want to render them, call render(GuiRender render).

Info

Because AbstractTextRenderDescription's getNode() method directly returns the outer class, you only need to provide methods that return RenderDescription.

Info

TextLabel uses CanWrappedTextRenderDescription, while TextBox's input field uses TextRenderDescription.

docs.title: InputBlocker
docs.text: Indicates that the user can accept events themselves. The AbstractInputBlocker base class provides a default implementation.

docs.title: ButtonNode
docs.text: Indicates that this node is a button.

docs.title: HasDrawBackground
docs.text: Indicates that this node has a drawBackground field. In other words, drawing the background is optional.

docs.title: Others
docs.text:
You may wonder: I cannot inherit from both TextNode and ImageNode at the same time, so how do I make a node that has both Text and Image?

The answer is: if you really need to render both at the same time, we recommend using a composite node approach.

For example, use a Frame as the container, with a TextLabel and an ImageLabel as child nodes.

We strongly do not recommend inheriting from GuiNode solely for the purpose of managing child nodes.

docs.title: Core Concepts
docs.text: This chapter will introduce several core concepts of this library.

docs.title: Basics
docs.text:
In this library, you will frequently see realXxx and xxx (where xxx is a field name). Generally, realXxx is the value actually passed to the GuiRender renderer, and it is an absolute value relative to the entire window. xxx is the user-provided input value. For performance reasons, realXxx is generally a scalar.

This library does not use window size at all. Any window size mentioned in the documentation refers to the framebuffer size.

docs.title: Inheritance Chain
docs.text:
ParentNode(sealed)
    -NodeRoot(final)
    -GuiNode(non-sealed)
        -Frame
        -ScrollFrame
        -TextNode
            -TextLabel
            -TextBox
            -TextButton
            ...
        -ImageNode
            -ImageLabel
            -ImageButton
            ...
        -LayoutBox
            -VerticalBox
            -HorizontalBox
            ...
        ...

ParentNode has these important protected fields:

int realPositionX

int realPositionY

int realPositionMaxX

int realPositionMaxY

int realSizeX

int realSizeY

float realAngle

Of the 7 values above, all are in pixels except realAngle, which is in degrees, and the result is rounded during calculation.

NodeRoot sets realPositionX, realPositionY, and realAngle to zero, and sets realSizeX, realSizeY, realPositionMaxX, and realPositionMaxY to the window size.

GuiNode recalculates these 7 values when it is initialized, when the parent requests recalculation, or when the parent is changed or position/size/angle is changed. After calculating them itself, it recursively asks its children to recalculate.

They all have self-referential generics and are not builders. All setters return the self field, where self is defined as (T) this, so you can chain calls on it at any time.

docs.title: ScaleOffset
docs.text:
ScaleOffset is a relatively important class in this library. It is an immutable record class, and the constructors of almost all nodes require position and size of type ScaleOffset. It is defined as:

public record ScaleOffset(double xScale, int xOffset, double yScale, int yOffset) {...}

The type of a node's position and size is both this.

There are 3 ways to construct it:

new ScaleOffset(xScale, xOffset, yScale, yOffset)

ScaleOffset.fromScale(xScale, yScale)

ScaleOffset.fromOffset(xOffset, yOffset)

and a fixed constant ZERO.

A node's final size is determined by its fields, and the algorithm is roughly:

parent.realSize * Scale + Offset

A node's final position is also determined by its fields, and the algorithm is roughly:

parent.realPosition + parent.realSize * Scale + Offset (Note: the final position is also affected by an additional Anchor; see below.)

(Note: NodeRoot's final size is the window size, and the coordinate origin and realPosition are located at 0,0.)

All GuiNode children have these public methods:

setPosition(ScaleOffset position)

setSize(ScaleOffset size)

ScaleOffset has many methods, such as

with series: withX withY withScale withOffset withXScale withXOffset ...

add series: addScale addOffset addX addY addXScale addXOffset ...

docs.title: Anchor
docs.text:
A node has an Anchor property, which affects the node's final coordinates.

It is not a record class, but consists of two double values: xAnchor, yAnchor.

It generally consists of 2 components in the range 0-1. Values outside this range are also legal, but may cause unexpected behavior, such as rendering outside the window.

Assuming x and y have already been calculated according to the formulas above, then realPositionX and realPositionY are:

x - this.realSizeX * xAnchor -> realPositionX

y - this.realSizeY * yAnchor -> realPositionY

All GuiNode children have these public methods:

setAnchor(double xAnchor, double yAnchor)

setXAnchor(double xAnchor)

setYAnchor(double yAnchor)

and these protected fields:

double xAnchor double yAnchor

For example:

node.setAnchor(0, 0); // Located at the top-left corner of the shape
node.setAnchor(0.5, 0.5); // Located at the center of the shape
node.setAnchor(1, 1); // Located at the bottom-right corner of the shape

docs.title: Angle and RealAngle
docs.text:
They control the clockwise angle when the node is rendered.

The rotation center is actually the center of the shape, not the Anchor point.

If you directly call GuiRender's triangle drawing method, the rotation center there is the triangle's centroid.

realAngle is calculated from its own angle + the parent's realAngle.

All GuiNode children have the setAngle(float angle) method.

For example:

node.setAngle(90f); // Rotate clockwise by 90 degrees

docs.title: RGBA
docs.text:
RGBA is an immutable record class, defined as:

public record RGBA(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha) {...}

Note: The range of these four values must all be 0-255.

Alpha is roughly equivalent to opacity. A value of 0 is completely transparent, and a value of 255 is completely opaque; the range is simply changed from 0-1 to 0-255.

It represents a color.

Almost all APIs use it to represent a color, for example GuiNode's backgroundColor.

It has four methods: withRed, withGreen, withBlue, and withAlpha.

There is 1 way to construct it:

new RGBA(red, green, blue, alpha)

or use constants defined by the RGBA class: WHITE BLACK RED GREEN BLUE GRAY TRANSPARENT

Example: Set a node's background color to opaque orange

node.background().setColor(new RGBA(255, 128, 0, 255));

        }

        long windowHandle1 = createWindow(800, 600, "Test1", null);
        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle1);
        GL.createCapabilities();
        glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
        Window window1 = Window.from(windowHandle1);
        window1.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
        NodeRoot root1 = window1.getNodeRoot();

        ImageButton button = new ImageButton(oiiacatBlue, ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))

        window2.close();
        otherWindow.close();
