    private static Window runOtherWindowInOtherThread(int width, int height, String title) throws InterruptedException {
        long handle = createWindow(width, height, title, null);
        Window window = Window.from(handle);
        CountDownLatch initLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
        Thread thread = new Thread(() -> {
            glfwMakeContextCurrent(handle);
            GL.createCapabilities();
            window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
            initLatch.countDown();
            NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

            TextLabel label = new TextLabel("Hello from other thread!", ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5));
            TextBox box = new TextBox(ScaleOffset.fromScale(0, 0), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)).setZIndex(100);

            ScaleOffsetTween tween1 = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.ZERO, ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), 10000L, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, false);
            ScaleOffsetTween tween2 = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), ScaleOffset.ZERO, 10000L, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, false);

            tween1.bindSetter(label::setPosition);
            tween2.bindSetter(label::setPosition);

            tween1.onComplete(tween2::play);
            tween2.onComplete(tween1::play);

            root.addChildren(label, box);

            root.getTweenScheduler().registerTweens(tween1, tween2);

            tween1.play();

            glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);

            while (!shouldClose.get()) {
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) {
                    root.runAllTasksOnCurrentThread();
                }
                glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
                root.render();
                glfwSwapBuffers(handle);
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) {
                    break;
                }
            }
            shouldClose.set(true);
        });
        thread.start();
        initLatch.await();
        return window;
    }
}

docs.title: Multiple Windows
docs.text: This chapter explains how to use multiple windows with this library.

docs.title: Basics
docs.text:
When using multiple windows, you should have one main loop. No matter how many threads you have, there can only be one main loop at any given time.

The main loop should be the only loop among these threads that calls glfwPollEvents.

docs.title: Rendering a Single Window in a Multi-Window Setup
docs.text: When you render a certain window, you should at least ensure that the current context is that window. You can use glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle) to update it.

docs.title: Single-Threaded Multi-Window
docs.text:
When you render multiple windows in a single thread, you should switch contexts, and it is best to have a main window that shares resources with child windows (the share parameter of glfwCreateWindow). If resources are not shared, Texture and Font cannot be shared.

For example (assuming that when one window closes, the other should also close):

private static long createWindow(int width, int height, String title, Window shared) {
    return glfwCreateWindow(width, height, title, MemoryUtil.NULL, shared == null ? MemoryUtil.NULL : shared.getWindowHandle());
}

public static void main(String[] args) {
    if (!glfwInit()) {
        throw new RuntimeException("Unable to initialize GLFW");
    }

    long windowHandle1 = createWindow(800, 600, "Test1", null);
    glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle1);
    GL.createCapabilities();
    glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
    Window window1 = Window.from(windowHandle1);
    window1.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
    NodeRoot root1 = window1.getNodeRoot();
    ResourceManager resourceManager1 = root1.getResourceManager();

    long windowHandle2 = createWindow(800, 600, "Test2", window1);
    glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle2);
    glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
    Window window2 = Window.from(windowHandle2);
    window2.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
    NodeRoot root2 = window2.getNodeRoot();
    ResourceManager resourceManager2 = root2.getResourceManager();

    Texture oiiacatBlue = resourceManager1.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-blue.jpg"); // Both windows can access it

    while (!glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle1) && !glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle2)) {
        glfwPollEvents();

        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle1);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
        root1.render();
        glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle1);

        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle2);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
        root2.render();
        glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle2);
    }

    window1.close();
    window2.close();

    glfwTerminate();
}

Warning

If you enable vertical sync, then each glfwSwapBuffers in the above code will block for one vertical sync period. Assuming your monitor's maximum frame rate is 120, the actual maximum frame rate will actually be 60.

docs.title: Multi-Threaded Multi-Window
docs.text:
When using multiple threads and multiple windows, do not share any resources. This is very important.

You should have at least one main window (main thread). Only it calls glfwPollEvents, and it should be responsible for calls to glfwCreateWindow and Window.from. window.init is the responsibility of that window's rendering thread.

Example of multi-threaded multi-window (assuming that when one window closes, the other should also close):

public class Main {
    private static final AtomicBoolean shouldClose = new AtomicBoolean(false);

    private static long createWindow(int width, int height, String title, Window shared) {
        return glfwCreateWindow(width, height, title, MemoryUtil.NULL, shared == null ? MemoryUtil.NULL : shared.getWindowHandle());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (!glfwInit()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Unable to initialize GLFW");
        }

        long windowHandle = createWindow(800, 600, "Main Thread", null);
        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle);
        GL.createCapabilities();
        glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
        Window window = Window.from(windowHandle);
        window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
        NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

        Window otherWindow = runOtherWindowInOtherThread(800, 600, "Other Thread");
        Thread thread = otherWindow.getRenderThread();

        while (!shouldClose.get() && !glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle)) {
            glfwPollEvents();

            glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
            root.render();
            glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle);
        }

        shouldClose.set(true);

        thread.join();

        window.close();
        otherWindow.close();

        glfwTerminate();
    }

    private static Window runOtherWindowInOtherThread(int width, int height, String title) throws InterruptedException {
        long handle = createWindow(width, height, title, null);
        Window window = Window.from(handle);
        CountDownLatch initLatch = new CountDownLatch(1); // Do not write it like this in production
        Thread thread = new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                glfwMakeContextCurrent(handle);
                GL.createCapabilities();
                window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
            } finally {
                initLatch.countDown();
            }
            NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

            glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);

            while (!shouldClose.get()) {
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) {
                    root.runAllTasksOnCurrentThread(); // To ensure UserRequestWindowCloseEvent is dispatched correctly
                }
                glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
                root.render();
                glfwSwapBuffers(handle);
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) { // If the user requested window close at the beginning and it was canceled after node dispatch, then this if block will not be entered
                    break;
                }
            }
            shouldClose.set(true);
        });
        thread.start();
        initLatch.await();
        return window;
    }
}

docs.title: Node Appearance
docs.text: This chapter will explain the common properties that every GuiNode has.

docs.title: ClipChildren
docs.text:
Type: boolean

Default: false

When enabled, all children will be restricted to render only within the parent's border. ClipChildren takes the node's corner radius into account and will rotate the clipping region along with the node's angle.

When enabled, hit testing will also consider this factor along the parent chain. In other words, as long as the player's mouse is not actually over a visible part of the node, hit testing will return false.

Example:

node.setClipChildren(true);

docs.title: DrawBackground
docs.text:
Type: boolean

Default: varies; some nodes are true, some are false

Most nodes have this property. If a node has this property, it must have a corresponding setter.

Generally, nodes that have this property implement the HasDrawBackground interface.

If this value is false, the entire background will not be rendered.

If you do not see a background and the node has a drawBackground property, first consider setting it to true.

docs.title: ZIndex
docs.text:
Type: int

Default: 0

As the name suggests, it determines the order in which a node is rendered and receives event dispatch under the same parent. The larger the number, the higher it renders and the earlier it receives events.

Example: Set node's ZIndex to 100

node.setZIndex(100);

docs.title: Background
docs.text:
background is a field that every node has, but if the subclass does not expose the ability to draw a background, setting it has no effect. Background configuration items are accessed through the background() method of the GuiNode base class. You can return to the node via the background configuration's getNode() method.

Example: Configure the background

Frame frame = new Frame(ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
        .background()
        .setColor(new RGBA(210, 230, 255, 90))
        .setCornerRadius(10)
        .getNode();

docs.title: BackgroundBlurStrength
docs.text:
Type: double

Default: 0

Range: 0.1-1 recommended; the actual value will be clamped to 0-2 on the renderer side

When enabled, Gaussian blur will be applied to all pixels of the background, and the region will rotate along with the node's angle.

If Alpha=255, no matter what value is set, it will have no effect, because an opaque node already directly covers the area, and blurring the pixels behind it is meaningless.

Example:

background.setBlurStrength(0.7);

docs.title: BackgroundColor
docs.text:
Type: RGBA

Default: RGBA.WHITE

The background color.

Example:

background.setColor(new RGBA(210, 230, 255, 90));

docs.title: BackgroundBorder
docs.text:
The BackgroundBorder property actually consists of 6 independent components of different types.

Of type int: leftBorderThickness rightBorderThickness topBorderThickness bottomBorderThickness

(The four values above must be >=0; otherwise, unexpected behavior may occur. The default values are all 0, and the unit is pixels.)

(If you do not want to call the setters for these four one by one, you can use setBorderThickness(int thickness) to set all four at once.)

Of type RGBA:

borderColor

(Default: RGBA.BLACK)

Of type ThicknessPosition:

borderThicknessPosition

(Default: OUTSIDE)

The four int values correspond to the border thickness of the four sides of the background, the RGBA value determines the border color, and the ThicknessPosition determines where the border is drawn.

ThicknessPosition has three values:

OUTSIDE (rendered outside the background)

INSIDE (rendered inside the background)

CENTER (rendered at the center of the background's border)

The values above are borders, so even if the node rotates, they will stay tightly attached to the background.

Example: Set a blue border 5 pixels thick, rendered inside the background, using the chained API

background.setBorderThickness(5)
    .setBorderColor(RGBA.BLUE)
    .setBorderThicknessPosition(ThicknessPosition.INSIDE);

docs.title: BackgroundCornerRadius
docs.text:
It consists of 4 independent components of type int:

leftTopCornerRadius rightTopCornerRadius leftBottomCornerRadius rightBottomCornerRadius

(They must be >=0; otherwise, unexpected behavior may occur. The default values are all 0, and the unit is the corner radius in pixels.)

(If you do not want to call the setters one by one, you can use setCornerRadius(int radius) to set all four at once.)

Example: Set the top-left corner radius to 5, bottom-right to 20, top-right to 30, bottom-left to 0, using the chained API

background.setLeftTopCornerRadius(5)
    .setRightTopCornerRadius(30)
    .setLeftBottomCornerRadius(0)
    .setRightBottomCornerRadius(20);

docs.title: Node Tree
docs.text: This chapter will explain the library's internal node tree model.

docs.title: ParentNode
docs.text: All nodes, including the root node, directly or indirectly inherit from ParentNode. It holds a children list. Therefore, all nodes can have children; a leaf node is simply a node without children.

docs.title: GuiNode
docs.text: GuiNode inherits from ParentNode, so it also has a children list. It also has a parent field and a root field.

docs.title: NodeRoot
docs.text:
NodeRoot inherits from ParentNode, so it also has a children list. Unlike GuiNode, as the node root, it has no parent, and its root is itself.

A NodeRoot instance has a runTask(Runnable task) method. Registered tasks will be executed before the next render.

docs.title: Children
docs.text:
When you call the addChild method on an instance of ParentNode and pass in a node instance, it does the following:

  1. If the node already has a parent: call the parent's removeChild method, passing in the node.

  2. Set node.parent to this.

  3. Add the node to the children list.

  4. Sort the children list in ascending order by the children's zIndex (smaller zIndex comes first; if zIndex is the same, insertion order is used).

  5. Recursively set the root of the children and the children's children to this node's root.

  6. Have the node recalculate its own position.

  7. Dispatch the init event (each node determines for itself whether it has been initialized; if it has, the event is not triggered).

If you look at the source code, you will find that ParentNode does not have the behavior of step 5, but its only two sealed subclasses both override this method to recursively set root.

ParentNode also has a convenience overload, addChildren, which uses varargs (GuiNode...) and iterates over the varargs list calling addChild.

When you call the removeChild method on an instance of ParentNode and pass in a node instance, it only does the following:

If it really has this child, then remove the node from the children list and set the node.parent field to null.

ParentNode also has a convenience overload, removeChildren, which also uses varargs (GuiNode...) and iterates over the varargs list calling removeChild.

Externally, the child node list can be obtained via getChildren() (an immutable view wrapped by Collections.unmodifiableList).

docs.title: Order in Which Various Events Are Triggered on the Node Tree
docs.text:
Rendering and notification events (such as window maximize/minimize) traverse children in forward order (parent nodes are processed first, then child nodes; purpose: child nodes can be drawn directly on top of parent nodes during rendering, and notification events being processed by parent nodes first allows parent nodes to update themselves before updating children).

Cancelable events such as mouse clicks and keyboard input traverse children in reverse order (child nodes are processed first, then parent nodes; purpose: the topmost nodes can receive mouse events, keyboard events, etc. first; otherwise, it would be very counterintuitive for the user to click the mouse and have the bottommost rendered node respond).

Warning

zIndex only affects the ordering of all child nodes under the same parent.

All GLFW events will be scheduled to the rendering thread using runTask for processing.

Below is a node tree for demonstration:

root
    -Frame1(zIndex=0)
        -Frame11(zIndex=-10)
        -Frame12(zIndex=1)
    -Frame2(zIndex=1)
        -Frame21(zIndex=100)
        -Frame22(zIndex=101)

Rendering order:

Frame1-Frame11-Frame12-Frame2-Frame21-Frame22

Mouse/keyboard event receiving order (if any node cancels the event, dispatch stops):

Frame22-Frame21-Frame2-Frame12-Frame11-Frame1

docs.title: Resources
docs.text: This chapter explains how to use ResourceManager to load resources, and how resource objects are used.

docs.title: ResourceManager
docs.text:
All resource loading should be done through ResourceManager. Resource loading calls should be made on the rendering thread (other threads can use root.runTask to schedule them onto the rendering thread), and must be after window.init has been called.

You can obtain the ResourceManager instance via the getResourceManager method of NodeRoot.

ResourceManager defines these methods:

Texture loadTexture(String path);
Texture loadTexture(String path, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadTexture(byte[] data);
Texture loadTexture(byte[] data, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(String path, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(String path, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(byte[] data, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(byte[] data, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Font loadFont(String path);

docs.title: Loading Fonts
docs.text:
Note: None of them cache. Each call re-uploads and returns a new Font.

To load a font, simply use loadFont(String path) to get a Font instance.

A Font instance can be passed to various nodes that need a Font, such as TextLabel.

textLabel.description().setFont(font);

Font is an immutable record, defined as:

public record Font(FT_Face face, String path, ByteBuffer data, int id) {}

It has a public int getStringWidth(String text, int fontSize) method and a public int getStringHeight(int fontSize) method so you can get the pixel space occupied.

The static method loadDefaultFont(GuiRender render) returns the default font (currently MiSans Regular in this version).

docs.title: Loading Textures
docs.text:
The core methods for loading textures are these:

Texture loadTexture(String path, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadTexture(byte[] data, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(String path, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(byte[] data, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);

Note: They do not cache. Each call re-uploads to the GPU and returns a new Texture.

The first function loads a normal texture. path is the path to the local texture (supports disk / inside jar). isLinear: pass false for pixel art, true for high-resolution images. The convenience overload defaults to true. (isLinear=true uses linear filtering, smooth when scaling; false uses nearest-neighbor, keeping pixels sharp when scaling. So pass false for pixel art, true for normal images.)

The third function loads a nice-slice (nine-patch) texture. path is the path to the local texture (supports disk / inside jar). NiceSliceType has two values: PROPORTIONAL and FIXED_BORDER.

PROPORTIONAL: The four corners are scaled according to the ratio of the target width to the original image width, changing naturally with the target size.

FIXED_BORDER: The four corners keep their original pixels; only the center and edges are stretched/tiled.

stretchInner indicates whether the center of the nice slice is tiled or stretched. isLinear is the same as above. left, right, top, bottom indicate the pixel distances from the four edges of the nice slice to the corresponding edges of the center.

The fourth function, compared to the second, and the second compared to the first, simply changes the texture acquisition path from the resource manager reading the bytes itself to letting you pass in the bytes.

Texture is an immutable record, defined as:

public record Texture(boolean isNiceSlice, NiceSliceType sliceType, boolean stretchInner, int textureId, int width, int height, int channel, String filePath, int left, int right, int top, int bottom) {...}

If it is not a nice slice, sliceType will be null, stretchInner is unspecified, and left, right, top, bottom are all -1.

If loaded from byte[], filePath is null.

Example: Construct a Button that fills the entire screen, centered on the screen. In the normal state, the texture is oiiaioiiai-blue.jpg, and the image alignment is FILL. In the hover state, it is oiiaioiiai-red.jpg. In the click state, it is oiiaioiiai-green.jpg. It will draw Frame's default background, with a corner radius of 10 pixels.

ResourceManager resourceManager = root.getResourceManager();

ImageButton button = new ImageButton(resourceManager.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-blue.jpg"), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(1.0, 1.0))
                .normal().setImageAlignment(ImageAlignment.FILL).getNode()
                .onHover().setTexture(resourceManager.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-red.jpg")).getNode()
                .onClick().setTexture(resourceManager.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-green.jpg")).getNode()
                .setAnchor(0.5, 0.5)
                .setDrawBackground(true)
                .background()
                .setCornerRadius(10)
                .getNode();

docs.title: Unloading Resources
docs.text:
The methods for unloading resources are these:

void unloadTexture(Texture texture);
default void unloadTexture(Texture... textures) {
    for (Texture texture : textures) {
        unloadTexture(texture);
    }
}
void unloadFont(Font font);
default void unloadFont(Font... fonts) {
    for (Font font : fonts) {
        unloadFont(font);
    }
}

They all free part of the memory resources. The other part depends on the underlying renderer implementation, and GPU resources also differ depending on the underlying renderer implementation.

Warning

Please unload resources with the ResourceManager that loaded them. Do not use another window's ResourceManager to unload.

docs.title: Tween
docs.text: This chapter explains how to use Tween (tween animation) in the library.

docs.title: Core Concepts
docs.text:
Essentially, no Tween is bound to any UI. It is fundamentally just a value that grows over time, and you can use it anywhere.

A Tween consists of two parts: a Tween object (the carrier of data and some operations) and a TweenFunction (the easing function, which determines how the value changes over time).

docs.title: Tween Scheduler
docs.text:
The Tween scheduler is a carrier that schedules a bunch of Tweens. In our library, NodeRoot has a Tween scheduler, which you can obtain via getTweenScheduler.

Each time the scheduler's step() method is called, it calls step(delta) on every registered Tween. A Tween only advances its value when stepped.

You can register/unregister Tweens with the scheduler using the following methods:

public void registerTween(Tween tween) {...}
public void registerTweens(Tween... tweens) {...}
public void unregisterTween(Tween tween) {...}
public void unregisterTweens(Tween... tweens) {...}

Warning

NodeRoot automatically steps its own Tween scheduler when rendering; you do not need to step it manually.

docs.title: Tween Objects
docs.text:
A Tween object is a carrier that holds data and grows its value over time. Currently, the library has three basic-type Tween objects: DoubleTween, FloatTween, and IntTween, and two composite-type Tween objects: ScaleOffsetTween and RGBATween.

A Tween object should have a method that returns its own value, such as the getCurrentValue method of the five objects listed above.

The Tween base class has methods such as pause(), resume(), reset(), and play().

pause: pause the Tween

resume: resume the Tween

reset: reset the Tween playback progress

play: calls reset() and resume()

You can call setAlwaysRepeat to set whether to repeat forever, and call setRemainingRepeatCount to set how many times the Tween repeats (not including the first time).

Warning

The time unit of a Tween object is milliseconds. A newly created Tween will not automatically play(); you need to call it manually.

Example: DoubleTween's setter binding method (bindSetter)

    public double getCurrentValue() {
        return currentValue;
    }

    public void bindSetter(DoubleConsumer consumer) {
        onUpdate(() -> consumer.accept(currentValue));
    }

The last parameter of the constructor of all Tween objects generally determines whether it is automatically removed by the Tween scheduler after it finishes playing.

Example: Create a ScaleOffsetTween that smoothly moves from Scale coordinate (0, 0) to (1, 1) over 5 seconds, and have some node's position apply it; it will be automatically removed by the scheduler after playback finishes.

ScaleOffsetTween scaleOffsetTween = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.ZERO, ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), 5000L, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, true);

scaleOffsetTween.bindSetter(node::setPosition);
// If it has not yet been registered with the scheduler
nodeRoot.getTweenScheduler().registerTween(scaleOffsetTween);

scaleOffsetTween.play();

Example: Make a tween repeat forever

tween.setAlwaysRepeat(true);

docs.title: Easing Functions (TweenFunction)
docs.text:
TweenFunction is an easing function. It determines what value (ratio) is output at a given progress (range 0-1).

In our library, TweenFunction is also a functional interface, defined as:

@FunctionalInterface
public interface TweenFunction {
    double computeEased(double percent);
}

Here, percent is always 0-1, representing the current Tween percentage progress. The return value represents the mapped progress, generally 0-1. For example, Linear directly returns percent, meaning no change; QUAD_IN squares it once before returning. You can also go above/below this range for advanced effects (such as Back, which overshoots and then returns).

docs.title: CustomTweenFunction
docs.text:
CustomTweenFunction is an important class in TweenFunction. It implements the TweenFunction interface, so it can be passed to any place that needs a TweenFunction.

It has two constructors:

    public CustomTweenFunction() {
        this(TweenFunctions.LINEAR);
    }
    public CustomTweenFunction(TweenFunction outOfRangeFunction) {
        setOutOfRangeFunction(outOfRangeFunction);
    }

The constructor parameter TweenFunction represents the function called if some interval to be used has not been registered.

It has three core methods:

    public CustomTweenFunction setSegment(double start, double end, TweenFunction function) {
        tweenFunctions.put(start, end, function);
        return this;
    }

    public CustomTweenFunction setNestedSegment(double start, double end, Consumer<CustomTweenFunction> function) {
        return setNestedSegment(start, end, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, function);
    }

    public CustomTweenFunction setNestedSegment(double start, double end, TweenFunction nestedOutOfRangeFunction, Consumer<CustomTweenFunction> nestedConfigurator) {
        CustomTweenFunction function = new CustomTweenFunction(nestedOutOfRangeFunction);
        setSegment(start, end, function);
        nestedConfigurator.accept(function);
        return this;
    }

Warning

The start and end above must be within 0-1; otherwise they may never be called.

Among them, the first method setSegment's parameters are: the start value of the interval, the end value of the interval, which easing function to use for the interval; returns this for convenient chaining.

The third method setNestedSegment creates a new nested CustomTweenFunction and stores it in itself. Its parameters are: the start value of the interval, the end value of the interval, the function called when some interval to be used by the new CustomTweenFunction has not been registered, and the configuration function for the new CustomTweenFunction (you can continue calling these three methods on it to achieve nesting); returns this for convenient chaining.

The second method is a convenience overload of the third method; the function called when some interval to be used by the new CustomTweenFunction has not been registered is always LINEAR.

Example 1: Construct an easing function whose first half is LINEAR and second half is QUAD_IN

CustomTweenFunction tweenFunction1 = new CustomTweenFunction()
                .setSegment(0, 0.5, TweenFunctions.LINEAR)
                .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.QUAD_IN);

Example 2: Register tweenFunction1 from Example 1 into the first half of another CustomFunction, and use CUBIC_IN for the second half

CustomTweenFunction tweenFunction2 = new CustomTweenFunction()
                .setSegment(0, 0.5, tweenFunction1)
                .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.CUBIC_IN);

The expected effect of Example 2 is: 0-0.5 enters tweenFunction1; 0-0.25 (tweenFunction1's 0-0.5) enters LINEAR; 0.25-0.5 (tweenFunction1's 0.5-1) enters QUAD_IN; 0.5-1 enters CUBIC_IN.

Example 3: Rewrite the final combined TweenFunction from Examples 1 and 2 as a direct chained construction

CustomTweenFunction tweenFunction3 = new CustomTweenFunction()
        .setNestedSegment(0, 0.5, function -> function
                .setSegment(0, 0.5, TweenFunctions.LINEAR)
                .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.QUAD_IN))
        .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.CUBIC_IN);

docs.title: NumberTween
docs.text:
NumberTween is an abstract class. Basic-type Tween classes generally inherit directly from it. It helps you manage target time, easing functions, etc. Subclasses only need to manage their own value and update their value by overriding the applyEased(double eased) function (generally you only need startValue + (endValue - startValue) * eased), reset their value by overriding resetTween, and provide getCurrentValue and bindSetter methods.

Warning

You generally need to call the parent class's triggerOnUpdateCallback method in the applyEased method when the value is updated; otherwise, registered update callbacks will not be triggered.

Example: IntTween class

public class IntTween extends NumberTween {
    private final int startValue;
    private final int endValue;
    private int currentValue;

    @Override
    protected void resetTween() {
        currentValue = startValue;
    }

    public IntTween(int startValue, int endValue, long time, TweenFunction function, boolean removeOnComplete) {
        super(time, function, removeOnComplete);
        this.startValue = startValue;
        this.currentValue = startValue;
        this.endValue = endValue;
    }

    @Override
    protected void applyEased(double eased) {
        currentValue = Maths.round(startValue + (endValue - startValue) * eased);
        triggerOnUpdateCallback();
    }

    public void bindSetter(IntConsumer consumer) {
        onUpdate(() -> consumer.accept(currentValue));
    }

    public int getCurrentValue() {
        return currentValue;
    }
}

docs.title: CompositeTween
docs.text:
CompositeTween: composite-type Tween classes generally inherit directly from it. It helps you manage children, update callbacks, manage bound setters, etc. Subclasses generally only need to register their child Tween objects with the parent class (using the parent class's addChildren or addChild methods), provide a getCurrentValue method, and fill the parent class's generic parameter with the type of the Tween's value.

Example: ScaleOffsetTween class

public class ScaleOffsetTween extends CompositeTween<ScaleOffset> {
    private final DoubleTween xScaleTween;
    private final IntTween xOffsetTween;
    private final DoubleTween yScaleTween;
    private final IntTween yOffsetTween;

    public ScaleOffset getCurrentValue() {
        return new ScaleOffset(xScaleTween.getCurrentValue(), xOffsetTween.getCurrentValue(), yScaleTween.getCurrentValue(), yOffsetTween.getCurrentValue());
    }

    public ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset start, ScaleOffset end, long time, TweenFunction function, boolean removeOnComplete) {
        super(removeOnComplete);
        xScaleTween = new DoubleTween(start.xScale(), end.xScale(), time, function, false);
        xOffsetTween = new IntTween(start.xOffset(), end.xOffset(), time, function, false);
        yScaleTween = new DoubleTween(start.yScale(), end.yScale(), time, function, false);
        yOffsetTween = new IntTween(start.yOffset(), end.yOffset(), time, function, false);

        addChildren(xScaleTween, xOffsetTween, yScaleTween, yOffsetTween);
    }
}

docs.title: First Use
docs.text:
This chapter will demonstrate initializing the library, embedding it into a render loop, and displaying a full-screen white rectangle on the screen.

This UI library does not have its own render loop; it is usually embedded directly into the host program.

When you have created a window and hold its window handle, you can do this to initialize the library:

Window window = Window.from(windowHandle); // Will register GLFW callbacks
window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL); // Will initialize the rendering backend

Warning

You should call Window.from on the thread that calls glfwPollEvent, and call window.init on the rendering thread.

Also, do not register any GLFW callbacks after Window.from. Your callbacks should be registered before Window.from.

After initializing the Window, you can get the GUI node root:

NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

Then, in your render loop, you can:

// Code before rendering the UI...
root.render();
// Code after rendering the UI, e.g. glfwSwapBuffers()...

This way, the UI library can perform rendering normally.

Now, we will render a rectangle covering the entire screen:

ScaleOffset position = ScaleOffset.ZERO; // Position at the top-left corner
ScaleOffset size = ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1); // Fill the parent node; here the parent node is NodeRoot, so filling the parent node means filling the entire screen
Frame frame = new Frame(position, size); // Create a new Frame object
root.addChild(frame); // Attach the Frame to the node root

For detailed usage of ScaleOffset, see the Core Concepts chapter.

Warning

Do not recreate the above code every time in the render loop, because we are a retained-mode UI library. This will cause a new Frame to be attached to the node tree every frame, severely degrading performance.

If there are no problems, you should see a white rectangle covering the entire screen.

docs.title: 自定义节点
docs.text:
自定义节点适用于内置节点无法表达的绘制.如果你能用现有节点组合出来,就不要自定义

本章将会介绍如何继承GuiNode,如何调用GuiRender的方法,如何响应事件.什么场景值得自定义取决于你的项目,如果某个需求足够普遍,库会提供内置节点

docs.title: 如何制作
docs.text:
你的自定义节点应该继承GuiNode<?>抽象类,并且泛型参数填自己的类型,如Frame extends GuiNode<Frame>

如果你最终决定自己制作自定义节点,那么你必须直接调用我们的渲染抽象层

你的类继承GuiNode后,必须重写render(GuiRender render, double delta)方法,其中delta单位为毫秒,当前版本我们不推荐使用delta来做动画,我们推荐使用Tween来做,Tween介绍在上一章节

你的构造函数应该至少拥有ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size并调用super(position, size)

你的所有setter方法应当返回this,如果你造的是抽象类那么请你定义为:Example<T extends Example<T>> extends GuiNode<T>并且所有setter返回T(使用父类字段self)

如果你希望绘制默认背景,请调用父类字段background的render方法,如果你的背景绘制是可选的,请加drawBackground属性(字段,setter与getter)并实现HasDrawBackground接口,泛型填自己的类型,默认值由节点类型自由决定

示例:最简单的仅仅调用父类background字段的render方法的Frame类

public class Frame extends GuiNode<Frame> {
    @Override
    protected void render(GuiRender render, double delta) {
        background.render(render);
    }

    public Frame(ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size) {
        super(position, size);
    }
}

示例:可选绘制背景的DemoFrame类

public class DemoFrame extends GuiNode<DemoFrame> implements HasDrawBackground<DemoFrame> {
    private boolean drawBackground = false;

    @Override
    public DemoFrame setDrawBackground(boolean drawBackground) {
        this.drawBackground = drawBackground;
        return self;
    }
    @Override
    public boolean isDrawBackground() {
        return drawBackground;
    }

    @Override
    protected void render(GuiRender render, double delta) {
        if (drawBackground) {
            background.render(render);
        }
    }

    public DemoFrame(ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size) {
        super(position, size);
    }
}

docs.title: 事件
docs.text:
你的节点可以任意监听你想要监听的事件

onXxx是给你的自定义节点重写用的钩子,dispatchXxx(包括dispatchRender)是分发流程,一般不需要重写

如果你仅仅是为了判断鼠标是否在节点内,建议使用父类的字段protected boolean mouseInNode

父类还帮你维护了目前有哪些鼠标按键点击了节点,protected Set<MouseButton> currentMouseClickButtons,如果你想取消事件的话你可以选择重写

示例:某Button的onMouseButtonEvent方法

@Override
    protected void onMouseButtonEvent(MouseButtonEvent event) {
        if (!Collections.disjoint(canTriggerMouseButtons, currentMouseClickButtons)) { //canTriggerMouseButtons是该节点自己的字段
            event.cancel();
            mouseButtonEventListenerRegistry.trigger(self, event); //self是ParentNode继承来的字段,类型为T
        }
    }

目前有这些方法可重写,重写之后在方法体内编写你想要的任何后续处理即可

//可取消事件(event.cancel()可用,调用会阻止后续分发)
protected void onKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseButtonEvent(MouseButtonEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseMoveEvent(MouseMoveEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseEnterWindowEvent(MouseEnterWindowEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseLeaveWindowEvent(MouseLeaveWindowEvent event) {}
protected void onMouseScrollEvent(MouseScrollEvent event) {}
protected void onUserInputTextEvent(UserInputTextEvent event) {}

protected void onUserDropFilesEvent(UserDropFilesEvent event) {}

docs.title: 中间层节点父类
docs.text: 本章节将会讲解几个节点的中间层抽象类,它们将提供某些方面的便捷API/类以供你使用

docs.title: ImageNode
docs.text:
ImageNode是图像节点的抽象基类,继承GuiNode,它内部定义了public class ImageRenderDescription(非static),这个类型拥有渲染一个图片所需的所有数据,所有方法返回它本身,以及getNode方法返回外部类

如果你要做的节点有图片,可以继承ImageNode

如果你要渲染ImageRenderDescription,调用render(GuiRender render)

如果你的节点有多个图片要管理,你可以像ImageButton的这三个方法设计你的API,normal,onHover,onClick,返回该状态对应的ImageRenderDescription

public ImageRenderDescription normal() {
    return normal;
}
public ImageRenderDescription onHover() {
    return onHover;
}
public ImageRenderDescription onClick() {
    return onClick;
}

Info

因为ImageRenderDescription的getNode()方法直接返回外部类,因此你只需要提供返回ImageRenderDescription的方法

示例:使用ImageRenderDescription并继承ImageNode的ImageLabel类

public class ImageLabel extends ImageNode<ImageLabel> implements HasDrawBackground<ImageLabel> {
    private final ImageRenderDescription imageRenderDescription;
    private boolean drawBackground = true;

    @Override
    public void render(GuiRender render, double delta) {
        if (drawBackground) background.render(render);
        imageRenderDescription.render(render);
    }

    @Override
    public ImageLabel setDrawBackground(boolean drawBackground) {
        this.drawBackground = drawBackground;
        return this;
    }
    @Override
    public boolean isDrawBackground() {
        return drawBackground;
    }

    public ImageRenderDescription getImageRenderDescription() {
        return imageRenderDescription;
    }

    @Override
    public void onRelayout() {
        operationImageAlignment();
    }

    private void operationImageAlignment() {
        imageRenderDescription.operationImageAlignment();
    }

    public ImageLabel(Texture texture, ScaleOffset position, ScaleOffset size) {
        super(position, size);
        this.imageRenderDescription = new ImageRenderDescription().setTexture(texture);
    }
}

docs.title: TextNode
docs.text:
TextNode是文字节点的抽象基类,继承GuiNode,它内部定义了

public abstract class AbstractTextRenderDescription

public class TextRenderDescription

public class CanWrappedTextRenderDescription

AbstractTextRenderDescription是非静态抽象基类,持有一个文字渲染所需的所有数据,比如字体,使用的相对于节点的对齐等

TextRenderDescription仅仅继承AbstractTextRenderDescription,泛型填TextRenderDescription,不添加额外行为

CanWrappedTextRenderDescription增加了wrap字段,setWrap与isWrap方法,用于控制自动换行

如果你要制作的节点要渲染文本,可以继承TextNode

Warning

CanWrappedTextRenderDescription会根据\n与节点宽度,各个字符的宽度自动换行,而TextRenderDescription就算遇见\n也不换行,且会渲染为notdef

如果你要渲染它们,调用render(GuiRender render)

Info

因为AbstractTextRenderDescription的getNode()方法直接返回外部类,因此你只需要提供返回RenderDescription的方法

Info

TextLabel使用了CanWrappedTextRenderDescription,而TextBox的输入框则使用了TextRenderDescription

docs.title: 其他
docs.text:
你可能会疑惑,我无法同时继承TextNode和ImageNode,那我怎么制作又有Text又有Image的节点?

答案是:如果你真的要同时渲染它们,我们推荐你使用组合节点的方式

比如一个Frame当容器,有一个TextLabel和ImageLabel作为子节点

我们十分不推荐你仅仅为了管理子节点而继承GuiNode

docs.title: 核心概念
docs.text: 本章节将会介绍本库的几个核心概念

docs.title: 基础
docs.text:
本库会频繁出现realXxx与xxx(xxx为字段名),realXxx一般来说才是真正传给GuiRender渲染器的值,并且是相对于整个窗口的绝对值,xxx是用户的输入值,realXxx为了性能一般均为标量

本库完全不使用窗口大小,文档提到的窗口大小均为FrameBuffer大小

docs.title: 继承链
docs.text:
ParentNode(sealed)
    -NodeRoot(final)
    -GuiNode(non-sealed)
        -Frame
        -ScrollFrame
        -TextNode
            -TextLabel
            -TextBox
            -TextButton
            ...
        -ImageNode
            -ImageLabel
            -ImageButton
            ...
        -LayoutBox
            -VerticalBox
            -HorizontalBox
            ...
        ...

ParentNode拥有这些重要的protected字段:

int realPositionX

int realPositionY

int realPositionMaxX

int realPositionMaxY

int realSizeX

int realSizeY

float realAngle

上列7个值除了realAngle单位为角度外均为像素,且计算时结果会取整

NodeRoot会把realPositionX realPositionY realAngle置零, 把realSizeX realSizeY realPositionMaxX realPositionMaxY 设置为窗口大小

GuiNode会在初始化,父项要求重算,改变父项或者更改position/size/angle的时候重新算这7个值,并且自己算完后递归子项让它们重算

它们都拥有自引用泛型,且不是builder,所有setter返回self字段,self定义为(T) this,因此你可以在任何时候链式调用它

docs.title: ScaleOffset
docs.text:
ScaleOffset是本库重要性较高的类.它是一个不可变记录类,几乎所有节点的构造函数都要求ScaleOffset类型的position和size,定义为:

public record ScaleOffset(double xScale, int xOffset, double yScale, int yOffset) {...}

节点的位置和大小的类型都是它

构造方式有3种:

new ScaleOffset(xScale, xOffset, yScale, yOffset)

ScaleOffset.fromScale(xScale, yScale)

ScaleOffset.fromOffset(xOffset, yOffset)

以及一个固定的常量ZERO

一个节点的最终大小由他的字段决定,算法大致为:

parent.realSize * Scale + Offset

一个节点的最终位置也是由他的字段决定,算法大致为:

parent.realPosition + parent.realSize * Scale + Offset (注意:最终位置还有额外的Anchor影响,请见下文)

(注意:NodeRoot的最终大小即为窗口大小,坐标原点和realPosition位于0,0)

所有GuiNode子项都有这些public方法:

setPosition(ScaleOffset position)

setSize(ScaleOffset size)

ScaleOffset有许多方法,比如

with系列: withX withY withScale withOffset withXScale withXOffset ...

add系列: addScale addOffset addX addY addXScale addXOffset ...

docs.title: Anchor
docs.text:
一个节点拥有Anchor属性,它会影响节点的最终坐标

它不是记录类,而是由两个double值组成:xAnchor, yAnchor

它一般由2个0-1的分量组成,超出该范围也是合法的,但是可能会造成非预期行为,例如渲染到了窗口之外

假设已经按照上文中的公式算出了x和y,那么realPositionX和realPositionY则是:

x - this.realSizeX * xAnchor -> realPositionX

y - this.realSizeY * yAnchor -> realPositionY

所有GuiNode的子项都有这些public方法

setAnchor(double xAnchor, double yAnchor)

setXAnchor(double xAnchor)

setYAnchor(double yAnchor)

以及这些protected字段 double xAnchor double yAnchor

例如:

node.setAnchor(0, 0); //位于图形左上角
node.setAnchor(0.5, 0.5); //位于图形中心
node.setAnchor(1, 1); //位于图形右下角

docs.title: Angle与RealAngle
docs.text:
它们控制节点渲染时候的顺时针角度

旋转中心实际为图形的中心而非Anchor所在点

如果你直接调用了GuiRender绘制三角形的方法,那里的旋转中心是三角形重心

realAngle是通过自己的angle+父项的realAngle算出来的

所有GuiNode的子项都有setAngle(float angle)方法

例如:

node.setAngle(90f); //顺时针旋转90度

docs.title: RGBA
docs.text:
RGBA是一个不可变记录类,定义为:

public record RGBA(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha) {...}

注意:这四个值的范围必须全部是0-255

Alpha大致等于不透明度,值为0则完全透明,值为255则完全不透明,只是范围从0-1换成了0-255

它代表一种颜色 API几乎全部用他表示一个颜色,例如GuiNode的backgroundColor 它有withRed,withGreen,withBlue,withAlpha这四个方法

构造方式有1种:

new RGBA(red, green, blue, alpha)

或者使用RGBA类定义的常量: WHITE BLACK RED GREEN BLUE GRAY TRANSPARENT

示例:设置某node的背景色为不透明橙色

node.background().setColor(new RGBA(255, 128, 0, 255));

                .setZIndex(100)
                .setDrawBackground(true)
                .description()
                .setWrap(true)
                .setFontSize(30)
                .setHorizontalAlignment(HorizontalAlignment.LEFT)
                .setVerticalAlignment(VerticalAlignment.TOP)
                .getNode()
                .background()
                .setColor(RGBA.GRAY)
                .getNode();
        box.addChildren(frame, frame3);
        root1.addChildren(box, button, blurBox, textBox, label);
        TweenScheduler tweenScheduler = root1.getTweenScheduler();
        tweenScheduler.registerTween(scaleOffsetTween);
        tweenScheduler.registerTween(scaleOffsetTween1);
        scaleOffsetTween.bindSetter(button::setPosition);
        scaleOffsetTween1.bindSetter(button::setPosition);
        scaleOffsetTween.play();

        ImageLabel window2ImageLabel = new ImageLabel(oiiacatGreen, ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
                .setAnchor(0.5, 0.5)
                ;
        TextBox window2TextBox = new TextBox(ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
                ;

        root2.addChildren(window2ImageLabel, window2TextBox);

        long previousTime = System.nanoTime();
        int frameCount = 0;

        Window otherWindow = runOtherWindowInOtherThread(800, 600, "Test3");
        Thread thread = otherWindow.getRenderThread();

        glfwSwapInterval(0);

        while (!shouldClose.get() && !glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle1) && !glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle2)) {
            glfwPollEvents();

            glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle1);
            glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
            root1.render();
            glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle1);

            glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle2);
            glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
            root2.render();
            glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle2);

            frameCount++;
            long currentTime = System.nanoTime();
            long elapsed = currentTime - previousTime;

            if (elapsed >= 1_000_000_000L) {
                double seconds = elapsed / 1_000_000_000.0;
                System.out.printf("FPS: %.2f%n", frameCount / seconds);
                frameCount = 0;
                previousTime = currentTime;
            }
        }

        shouldClose.set(true);

        thread.join();

        resourceManager1.unloadTexture(oiiacatBlue, oiiacatRed, oiiacatGreen);

        window1.close();
        window2.close();
        otherWindow.close();

        glfwTerminate();
    }

    private static Window runOtherWindowInOtherThread(int width, int height, String title) throws InterruptedException {
        long handle = createWindow(width, height, title, null);
        Window window = Window.from(handle);
        CountDownLatch initLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
        Thread thread = new Thread(() -> {
            glfwMakeContextCurrent(handle);
            GL.createCapabilities();
            window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
            initLatch.countDown();
            NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

            TextLabel label = new TextLabel("Hello from other thread!", ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5));
            TextBox box = new TextBox(ScaleOffset.fromScale(0, 0), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)).setZIndex(100);

            ScaleOffsetTween tween1 = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.ZERO, ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), 10000L, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, false);
            ScaleOffsetTween tween2 = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), ScaleOffset.ZERO, 10000L, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, false);

            tween1.bindSetter(label::setPosition);
            tween2.bindSetter(label::setPosition);

            tween1.onComplete(tween2::play);
            tween2.onComplete(tween1::play);

            root.addChildren(label, box);

            root.getTweenScheduler().registerTweens(tween1, tween2);

            tween1.play();

            glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);

            while (!shouldClose.get()) {
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) {
                    root.runAllTasksOnCurrentThread();
                }
                glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
                root.render();
                glfwSwapBuffers(handle);
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) {
                    break;
                }
            }
            shouldClose.set(true);
        });
        thread.start();
        initLatch.await();
        return window;
    }
}

docs.title: 多窗口
docs.text: 本章节将会讲解如何在本库使用多窗口

docs.title: 基础
docs.text:
使用多窗口时,你应该有一个主循环,无论你有多少个线程,同一时刻只能有一个主循环

主循环应该是当前这几个线程中唯一会调用glfwPollEvents的循环

docs.title: 多窗口下的单个窗口的渲染
docs.text: 当你渲染某窗口时,你应该至少确保ContextCurrent为当前窗口,你可以使用glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle)来更新

docs.title: 单线程多窗口
docs.text:
当你单线程渲染多个窗口时,你应该做到切换上下文,并且最好拥有一个主窗口,与子窗口共享资源(glfwCreateWindow的share参数),如果不共享资源那么Texture和Font无法共用

例如(假设一个窗口关闭另外一个也要关闭):

private static long createWindow(int width, int height, String title, Window shared) {
    return glfwCreateWindow(width, height, title, MemoryUtil.NULL, shared == null ? MemoryUtil.NULL : shared.getWindowHandle());
}

public static void main(String[] args) {
    if (!glfwInit()) {
        throw new RuntimeException("Unable to initialize GLFW");
    }

    long windowHandle1 = createWindow(800, 600, "Test1", null);
    glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle1);
    GL.createCapabilities();
    glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
    Window window1 = Window.from(windowHandle1);
    window1.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
    NodeRoot root1 = window1.getNodeRoot();
    ResourceManager resourceManager1 = root1.getResourceManager();

    long windowHandle2 = createWindow(800, 600, "Test2", window1);
    glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle2);
    glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
    Window window2 = Window.from(windowHandle2);
    window2.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
    NodeRoot root2 = window2.getNodeRoot();
    ResourceManager resourceManager2 = root2.getResourceManager();

    Texture oiiacatBlue = resourceManager1.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-blue.jpg"); //两个窗口都可以访问

    while (!glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle1) && !glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle2)) {
        glfwPollEvents();

        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle1);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
        root1.render();
        glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle1);

        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle2);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
        root2.render();
        glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle2);
    }

    window1.close();
    window2.close();

    glfwTerminate();
}

Warn

如果你开了垂直同步,那么上述代码的glfwSwapBuffers每一个都会阻塞一个垂直同步周期,假设你显示器最大帧率120,那么实际最大帧率其实是60

docs.title: 多线程多窗口
docs.text:
当你多线程多窗口的时候,不要share任何资源,这很重要

你应该至少有一个主窗口(主线程),只有他调用glfwPollEvents,且glfwCreateWindow与Window.from的调用都应该由他负责,window.init才是那个窗口的渲染线程负责

多线程多窗口示例(假设一个窗口关闭另外一个也要关闭):

public class Main {
    private static final AtomicBoolean shouldClose = new AtomicBoolean(false);

    private static long createWindow(int width, int height, String title, Window shared) {
        return glfwCreateWindow(width, height, title, MemoryUtil.NULL, shared == null ? MemoryUtil.NULL : shared.getWindowHandle());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (!glfwInit()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Unable to initialize GLFW");
        }

        long windowHandle = createWindow(800, 600, "Main Thread", null);
        glfwMakeContextCurrent(windowHandle);
        GL.createCapabilities();
        glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);
        Window window = Window.from(windowHandle);
        window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
        NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

        Window otherWindow = runOtherWindowInOtherThread(800, 600, "Other Thread");
        Thread thread = otherWindow.getRenderThread();

        while (!shouldClose.get() && !glfwWindowShouldClose(windowHandle)) {
            glfwPollEvents();

            glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
            root.render();
            glfwSwapBuffers(windowHandle);
        }

        shouldClose.set(true);

        thread.join();

        window.close();
        otherWindow.close();

        glfwTerminate();
    }

    private static Window runOtherWindowInOtherThread(int width, int height, String title) throws InterruptedException {
        long handle = createWindow(width, height, title, null);
        Window window = Window.from(handle);
        CountDownLatch initLatch = new CountDownLatch(1); //生产环境不要这么写
        Thread thread = new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                glfwMakeContextCurrent(handle);
                GL.createCapabilities();
                window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL);
            } finally {
                initLatch.countDown();
            }
            NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

            glClearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f);

            while (!shouldClose.get()) {
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) {
                    root.runAllTasksOnCurrentThread(); //为了确保正确分发UserRequestWindowCloseEvent
                }
                glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
                root.render();
                glfwSwapBuffers(handle);
                if (glfwWindowShouldClose(handle)) { //如果在开头用户请求关闭窗口,节点分发后被取消,那么if块不会进入
                    break;
                }
            }
            shouldClose.set(true);
        });
        thread.start();
        initLatch.await();
        return window;
    }
}

docs.title: 节点外观
docs.text: 本章节将会讲解每个GuiNode都会有的共用属性.

docs.title: ClipChildren
docs.text:
类型:boolean

默认值:false

启用后将会限制所有子项只能渲染在父项的边框内.ClipChildren会考虑节点的圆角值,且会跟随节点的角度旋转区域

启用后命中测试也会考虑父链上的该因素,换句话说只要玩家鼠标没有真正放到节点可见的地方那么命中测试就会返回false

示例:

node.setClipChildren(true);

docs.title: DrawBackground
docs.text:
类型:boolean

默认值:不定,某些节点true,有些false

大部分节点都有这个属性,如果有这个属性那么该节点就必定有对应setter

一般拥有该属性的节点都会实现HasDrawBackground接口

如果该值为false,整个背景将不会渲染

如果你没看到背景,且节点有drawBackground属性,优先考虑将它设为true

docs.title: ZIndex
docs.text:
类型:int

默认值:0

顾名思义,他决定节点渲染/事件分发在同一父项下分发的顺序,数字越大,渲染越靠上,事件越先收到

示例:把node的ZIndex设置为100

node.setZIndex(100);

docs.title: Background
docs.text:
background是每个节点都会有的字段,但是如果子类未暴露出绘制背景的能力则设置他无效 背景配置项通过GuiNode基类的background()方法访问,你可以通过背景配置项的getNode()方法来回到节点

示例:配置背景

Frame frame = new Frame(ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
                .background()
                .setColor(new RGBA(210, 230, 255, 90))
                .setCornerRadius(10)
                .getNode();

docs.title: BackgroundBlurStrength
docs.text:
类型:double

默认值:0

范围:推荐0.1-1 实际值将会在渲染器侧钳制到0-2

启用后将会对背景所有像素应用高斯模糊,会跟随节点的角度旋转区域

如果Alpha=255,无论设置值为多少都将没有任何效果,因为不透明节点,本来也是直接覆盖,模糊后面的像素无意义

示例:

background.setBlurStrength(0.7);

docs.title: BackgroundColor
docs.text:
类型:RGBA

默认值:RGBA.WHITE

背景的颜色

示例:

background.setColor(new RGBA(210, 230, 255, 90));

docs.title: BackgroundBorder
docs.text:
BackgroundBorder属性实际由6个类型不同的独立分量组成

类型为int的: leftBorderThickness rightBorderThickness topBorderThickness bottomBorderThickness

(以上这四个值必须>=0否则会出现非预期行为,默认值都是0,单位为像素)

(如果你不想一个个调用这四个的setter,可以使用setBorderThickness(int thickness)一键设置四个)

类型为RGBA的:

borderColor

(默认值为RGBA.BLACK)

类型为ThicknessPosition的:

borderThicknessPosition

(默认值为OUTSIDE)

类型为int的4个分别对应背景四条边的边框厚度,类型为RGBA的决定边框的颜色,类型为ThicknessPosition的决定边框在哪

ThicknessPosition有三个值:

OUTSIDE(渲染在背景外)

INSIDE(渲染在背景内)

CENTER(渲染在背景的边框中心)

以上的值都是边框因此即使节点旋转它也会紧贴背景

示例:设置一个大小为5像素的蓝色边框,渲染在背景内,使用链式API

background.setBorderThickness(5)
    .setBorderColor(RGBA.BLUE)
    .setBorderThicknessPosition(ThicknessPosition.INSIDE);

docs.title: BackgroundCornerRadius
docs.text:
它由4个类型为int的独立分量组成

leftTopCornerRadius rightTopCornerRadius leftBottomCornerRadius rightBottomCornerRadius

(它们必须>=0否则会出现非预期行为,默认值都是0,单位是像素圆角半径)

(如果你不想一个个调用setter,可以使用setCornerRadius(int radius)一键设置四个)

示例:设置左上角圆角半径为5,右下角为20,右上角为30,左下角为0,使用链式API

background.setLeftTopCornerRadius(5)
    .setRightTopCornerRadius(30)
    .setLeftBottomCornerRadius(0)
    .setRightBottomCornerRadius(20);

docs.title: 节点树
docs.text: 本章节将会讲解库内部的节点树模型

docs.title: ParentNode
docs.text: 所有节点,包括根节点都直接或间接继承ParentNode.它持有children列表.因此所有节点都可以有子项,叶子节点仅仅是没有子项的节点

docs.title: GuiNode
docs.text: GuiNode继承ParentNode,因此也有children列表.它还拥有parent字段与root字段.

docs.title: NodeRoot
docs.text:
NodeRoot继承ParentNode,因此它也有children列表.与GuiNode不同,它作为节点根,没有parent,root就是他自己.

NodeRoot实例拥有runTask(Runnable task)方法,注册的任务将会在下次渲染前执行

docs.title: Children
docs.text:
当你调用了ParentNode的某个实例的addChild方法并传入了某node实例的时候,它会做这些事:

1.如果node已有父项:调用父项的removeChild方法,传入node

2.把node的parent设置为this

3.把node添加进children列表

4.按子项的zIndex升序(zIndex小的在前面,zIndex一样则按插入顺序)排序children列表

5.递归设置子项以及子项的root为this的root

6.让node重新计算自己的位置

7.分发init事件(各个节点自己判断有没有init过,如果init过了就不触发)

如果你翻看源码会发现ParentNode没有第5步的行为,但是它通过sealed的唯二子类都重写了这个方法递归设置root

ParentNode还有一个addChildren便捷重载,它使用变长参数(GuiNode...),遍历这个变长参数列表调用addChild

当你调用了ParentNode的某个实例的removeChild方法并传入了某node实例后,它只会做这些:

如果自己真的有这个子项,那么将node从children列表移除,node.parent字段置空

ParentNode还有一个removeChildren便捷重载,它也使用变长参数(GuiNode...),遍历这个变长参数列表调用removeChild

外部可以通过getChildren()拿到子节点列表(Collections.unmodifiableList包装的不可变视图)

docs.title: 各种事件在节点树上触发的顺序
docs.text:
渲染和通知性事件(比如窗口最大化最小化)按正序遍历children(父节点先处理,子节点再处理,目的:子节点渲染能直接画在父节点之上,且通知性事件父节点先处理可以让父节点先更新自己再更新子项)

鼠标点击,键盘输入等可取消事件按反序遍历children(子节点先处理,父节点再处理,目的:最上层节点能优先接收到鼠标事件,键盘事件等,否则用户点击鼠标是在最底层渲染的节点响应很反直觉)

Warn

zIndex只影响同一个父项下所有子节点的排序

所有GLFW事件都会使用runTask调度到渲染线程来处理

以下是一个演示用的节点树

root
    -Frame1(zIndex=0)
        -Frame11(zIndex=-10)
        -Frame12(zIndex=1)
    -Frame2(zIndex=1)
        -Frame21(zIndex=100)
        -Frame22(zIndex=101)

渲染顺序:

Frame1-Frame11-Frame12-Frame2-Frame21-Frame22

鼠标/键盘事件接受顺序(任意一个节点取消了事件会停止分发)

Frame22-Frame21-Frame2-Frame12-Frame11-Frame1

docs.title: 资源
docs.text: 本章将会讲解如何使用ResourceManager加载资源,以及资源对象如何使用.

docs.title: ResourceManager
docs.text:
所有资源的加载都应该通过ResourceManager.加载资源的调用应该在渲染线程使用(其他线程可以使用root.runTask调度到渲染线程),并且必须在window.init调用之后

你可以通过NodeRoot的getResourceManager方法获取ResourceManager实例.

ResourceManager定义了这些方法:

Texture loadTexture(String path);
Texture loadTexture(String path, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadTexture(byte[] data);
Texture loadTexture(byte[] data, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(String path, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(String path, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(byte[] data, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(byte[] data, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Font loadFont(String path);

docs.title: 加载字体
docs.text:
注意:他们都不会缓存,每次都会重新上传,返回新的Font

加载字体仅需通过loadFont(String path)即可获取Font实例

Font实例可以传给各种需要Font的节点,如TextLabel

textLabel.description().setFont(font);

Font是个不可变记录,定义为:

public record Font(FT_Face face, String path, ByteBuffer data, int id) {}

它拥有public int getStringWidth(String text, int fontSize)方法与public int getStringHeight(int fontSize)方法让你获取占用的像素

静态方法loadDefaultFont(GuiRender render)返回默认字体(当前版本为MiSans Regular)

docs.title: 加载贴图
docs.text:
加载贴图的核心方法是这些:

Texture loadTexture(String path, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadTexture(byte[] data, boolean isLinear);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(String path, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);
Texture loadNiceSliceTexture(byte[] data, NiceSliceType type, boolean stretchInner, boolean isLinear, int left, int right, int top, int bottom);

注意:他们都不会缓存,每次都会重新上传到GPU,返回新的Texture

第一个函数加载普通纹理,path表示本地纹理的路径(支持硬盘/jar内部),isLinear:像素风传false,高分辨率传true,便捷重载默认传true (isLinear=true使用线性过滤,缩放时平滑,false使用最近邻,缩放时保持像素锐利.所以像素画传false,普通图片传true)

第三个函数加载九宫格纹理,path表示本地纹理的路径(支持硬盘/jar内部),NiceSliceType有PROPORTIONAL FIXED_BORDER两种

PROPORTIONAL:四个角按目标宽度与原图宽度的比例缩放,跟随目标尺寸自然变化

FIXED_BORDER:四个角保持原始像素,只有中心和边被拉伸/平铺

stretchInner表示九宫格中心是平铺还是拉伸,isLinear同上,left,right,top,bottom表示九宫格的四个边离中心的对应边的像素距离

第四个函数对比第二个函数,第二个函数对比第一个函数仅仅是把纹理获取路径从资源管理器自己读字节改为了让你传字节

Texture是一个不可变记录,定义为:

public record Texture(boolean isNiceSlice, NiceSliceType sliceType, boolean stretchInner, int textureId, int width, int height, int channel, String filePath, int left, int right, int top, int bottom) {...}

如果它不是九宫格,sliceType将是null,stretchInner不定,left,right,top,bottom都是-1

如果从byte[]加载,filePath是null

示例:构造一个Button,占满全屏,在屏幕正中心,normal状态下贴图是oiiaioiiai-blue.jpg,且图片对齐为FILL,鼠标悬停状态下是oiiaioiiai-red.jpg,点击状态下是oiiaioiiai-green.jpg,会绘制Frame的默认背景,圆角半径为10像素

ResourceManager resourceManager = root.getResourceManager();

ImageButton button = new ImageButton(resourceManager.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-blue.jpg"), ScaleOffset.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ScaleOffset.fromScale(1.0, 1.0))
                .normal().setImageAlignment(ImageAlignment.FILL).getNode()
                .onHover().setTexture(resourceManager.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-red.jpg")).getNode()
                .onClick().setTexture(resourceManager.loadTexture("/oiiaioiiai-green.jpg")).getNode()
                .setAnchor(0.5, 0.5)
                .setDrawBackground(true)
                .background()
                .setCornerRadius(10)
                .getNode();

docs.title: 卸载资源
docs.text:
卸载资源的方法有这些:

void unloadTexture(Texture texture);
default void unloadTexture(Texture... textures) {
    for (Texture texture : textures) {
        unloadTexture(texture);
    }
}
void unloadFont(Font font);
default void unloadFont(Font... fonts) {
    for (Font font : fonts) {
        unloadFont(font);
    }
}

它们都会释放部分内存资源,另一部分根据底层渲染器实现不同,GPU资源根据底层渲染器实现不同也不一样

Warn

请在你加载资源的ResourceMangaer卸载资源,不要用别的窗口的ResourceMangaer卸载

docs.title: Tween
docs.text: 本章节将会讲解库内的Tween(补间动画)的使用方式

docs.title: 核心概念
docs.text:
所有Tween本质不绑定任何UI,它本质只是一个根据时间增长的值,你可以将它用在任何地方

Tween由Tween对象(数据和部分操作的载体)与TweenFunction(缓动函数,决定如何随着时间变化)两部分组成

docs.title: Tween调度器
docs.text:
Tween调度器是一个调度一堆Tween的载体.在我们的库中,NodeRoot就有一个Tween调度器,你可以通过getTweenScheduler来获取

调度器每次被调用step()方法的时候都会调用注册的每个Tween的step(delta),Tween只有被step才会推进值

你可以通过以下几个方法来注册/取消注册Tween到调度器

public void registerTween(Tween tween) {...}
public void registerTweens(Tween... tweens) {...}
public void unregisterTween(Tween tween) {...}
public void unregisterTweens(Tween... tweens) {...}

Warning

NodeRoot在渲染时会自动步进它自己的Tween调度器,你不需要手动步进

docs.title: Tween对象
docs.text:
Tween对象是承载数据的载体,它跟随时间增长自己的值.目前库内拥有DoubleTween FloatTween IntTween三种基本类型的Tween对象 与ScaleOffsetTween RGBATween 两种复合类型的Tween对象

一个Tween对象应有能返回自己值的方法,如上列五种对象的getCurrentValue方法

Tween基类拥有pause(), resume(), reset(), play()等方法

pause:暂停Tween

resume:恢复Tween

reset:重置Tween播放进度

play:调用reset()和resume()

你可以调用setAlwaysRepeat设置是否永久重复播放,调用setRemainingRepeatCount设置重复几次Tween(不含首次)

Warning

Tween对象的时间单位是毫秒 一个Tween new出来不会自动play(),你需要手动调用

示例:DoubleTween的绑定Setter的方法(bindSetter)

    public double getCurrentValue() {
        return currentValue;
    }

    public void bindSetter(DoubleConsumer consumer) {
        onUpdate(() -> consumer.accept(currentValue));
    }

所有Tween对象的构造函数最后一个参数一般决定它在播放完后是否被Tween调度器自动移除

示例:创建一个ScaleOffsetTween,使用5秒时间从Scale坐标(0, 0)平滑移到(1, 1),并让某node的position应用它,播放完成后自动被调度器移除

ScaleOffsetTween scaleOffsetTween = new ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset.ZERO, ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1), 5000L, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, true);

scaleOffsetTween.bindSetter(node::setPosition);
//如果还没注册到调度器的话
nodeRoot.getTweenScheduler().registerTween(scaleOffsetTween);

scaleOffsetTween.play();

示例:永久重复播放某tween

tween.setAlwaysRepeat(true);

docs.title: 缓动函数(TweenFunction)
docs.text:
TweenFunction是缓动函数,它决定进度(范围0-1)在某处的时侯输出的值(比例)是多少

TweenFunction在我们的库中还是一个函数式接口,定义为:

@FunctionalInterface
public interface TweenFunction {
    double computeEased(double percent);
}

其中,percent恒为0-1,代表当前Tween百分比进度,返回值代表映射后的进度,一般是0-1,比如Linear直接返回percent表示不做改变,QUAD_IN先做一次平方再返回,你也可以超过/低于这个值以做高级效果(如Back,冲过再返回)

docs.title: 内置缓动函数库(TweenFunctions)
docs.text:
TweenFunctions是我们的预制补间动画库,它拥有三十多种类型,你可以自由使用,自由搭配

所有类型 组 常量 效果 Linear LINEAR 匀速 Sine SINE_IN 正弦加速进入 Sine SINE_OUT 正弦减速退出 Sine SINE_IN_OUT 正弦两端缓入缓出 Quad QUAD_IN 二次加速进入 Quad QUAD_OUT 二次减速退出 Quad QUAD_IN_OUT 二次两端缓入缓出 Cubic CUBIC_IN 三次加速进入 Cubic CUBIC_OUT 三次减速退出 Cubic CUBIC_IN_OUT 三次两端缓入缓出 Quart QUART_IN 四次加速进入 Quart QUART_OUT 四次减速退出 Quart QUART_IN_OUT 四次两端缓入缓出 Quint QUINT_IN 五次加速进入 Quint QUINT_OUT 五次减速退出 Quint QUINT_IN_OUT 五次两端缓入缓出 Expo EXPO_IN 指数加速进入 Expo EXPO_OUT 指数减速退出 Expo EXPO_IN_OUT 指数两端缓入缓出 Circ CIRC_IN 圆形加速进入 Circ CIRC_OUT 圆形减速退出 Circ CIRC_IN_OUT 圆形两端缓入缓出 Back BACK_IN 起步先往回拉一下再前进 Back BACK_OUT 到达时冲过头再退回 Back BACK_IN_OUT 两端都有回拉 Elastic ELASTIC_IN 弹性震荡进入 Elastic ELASTIC_OUT 弹性震荡退出 Elastic ELASTIC_IN_OUT 弹性震荡两端 Bounce BOUNCE_IN 弹跳进入 Bounce BOUNCE_OUT 弹跳退出 Bounce BOUNCE_IN_OUT 弹跳两端 Other SMOOTHSTEP 平滑阶跃 Other SMOOTHERSTEP 更平滑的阶跃 后缀 含义 _IN 慢启动 _OUT 慢结束 _IN_OUT 两端都慢

docs.title: CustomTweenFunction
docs.text:
CustomTweenFunction是TweenFunction中重要的类.它实现了TweenFunction接口,因此它可以传给任何需要TweenFunction的地方

它有两个构造函数:

    public CustomTweenFunction() {
        this(TweenFunctions.LINEAR);
    }
    public CustomTweenFunction(TweenFunction outOfRangeFunction) {
        setOutOfRangeFunction(outOfRangeFunction);
    }

构造参数TweenFunction代表如果某个要用的区间没有被注册所调用的函数

它有三个核心方法:

    public CustomTweenFunction setSegment(double start, double end, TweenFunction function) {
        tweenFunctions.put(start, end, function);
        return this;
    }

    public CustomTweenFunction setNestedSegment(double start, double end, Consumer<CustomTweenFunction> function) {
        return setNestedSegment(start, end, TweenFunctions.LINEAR, function);
    }

    public CustomTweenFunction setNestedSegment(double start, double end, TweenFunction nestedOutOfRangeFunction, Consumer<CustomTweenFunction> nestedConfigurator) {
        CustomTweenFunction function = new CustomTweenFunction(nestedOutOfRangeFunction);
        setSegment(start, end, function);
        nestedConfigurator.accept(function);
        return this;
    }

Warning

上面的start,end必须在0-1之内,否则可能永远不会被调用

其中,第一个方法setSegment的参数有:该区间开始值,该区间结束值,该区间使用什么缓动函数,返回this方便链式调用

第三个方法setNestedSegment会新建一个嵌套的CustomTweenFunction存入自己,参数有:该区间开始值,该区间结束值,新的CustomTweenFunction某个要用的区间没有被注册所调用的函数,新的CustomTweenFunction的配置函数(你可以在那上面继续调用该三个方法,实现嵌套),返回this方便链式调用

第二个方法是第三个方法的便捷重载,新的CustomTweenFunction某个要用的区间没有被注册所调用的函数恒为LINEAR

示例1:构造一个前半段LINEAR,后半段QUAD_IN的缓动函数

CustomTweenFunction tweenFunction1 = new CustomTweenFunction()
                .setSegment(0, 0.5, TweenFunctions.LINEAR)
                .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.QUAD_IN);

示例2:将示例1的tweenFunction1注册到另外一个CustomFunction的前半段,后半段使用CUBIC_IN

CustomTweenFunction tweenFunction2 = new CustomTweenFunction()
                .setSegment(0, 0.5, tweenFunction1)
                .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.CUBIC_IN);

示例2的预期效果为:0-0.5进入tweenFunction1,0-0.25(tweenFunction1的0-0.5)进入LINEAR,0.25-0.5(tweenFunction1的0.5-1)进入QUAD_IN,0.5-1进入CUBIC_IN

示例3:将示例1和示例2最终组合的TweenFunction改成链式调用直接构造

CustomTweenFunction tweenFunction3 = new CustomTweenFunction()
        .setNestedSegment(0, 0.5, function -> function
                .setSegment(0, 0.5, TweenFunctions.LINEAR)
                .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.QUAD_IN))
        .setSegment(0.5, 1, TweenFunctions.CUBIC_IN);

docs.title: NumberTween
docs.text:
NumberTween是一个抽象类,基本类型的Tween类一般直接继承他.它会帮你管理目标时间,缓动函数等,子类仅需管理自己的值并且通过重写applyEased(double eased)函数来更新自己的值(一般来说你只需要startValue + (endValue - startValue) * eased),通过重写resetTween来重置自己的值,并且提供getCurrentValue方法与bindSetter方法

Warning

你一般需要在applyEased方法中,值更新的时候调用父类的triggerOnUpdateCallback方法,否则注册的更新回调不会触发

示例:IntTween类

public class IntTween extends NumberTween {
    private final int startValue;
    private final int endValue;
    private int currentValue;

    @Override
    protected void resetTween() {
        currentValue = startValue;
    }

    public IntTween(int startValue, int endValue, long time, TweenFunction function, boolean removeOnComplete) {
        super(time, function, removeOnComplete);
        this.startValue = startValue;
        this.currentValue = startValue;
        this.endValue = endValue;
    }

    @Override
    protected void applyEased(double eased) {
        currentValue = Maths.round(startValue + (endValue - startValue) * eased);
        triggerOnUpdateCallback();
    }

    public void bindSetter(IntConsumer consumer) {
        onUpdate(() -> consumer.accept(currentValue));
    }

    public int getCurrentValue() {
        return currentValue;
    }
}

docs.title: CompositeTween
docs.text:
CompositeTween,复合类型的Tween类一般直接继承他,它会帮你管理子项,更新回调,管理绑定的setter等,子类一般仅需把自己的子Tween对象注册给父类(使用父类的addChildren或addChild方法),提供getCurrentValue方法,将父类的泛型参数填为Tween的值的类型

示例:ScaleOffsetTween类

public class ScaleOffsetTween extends CompositeTween<ScaleOffset> {
    private final DoubleTween xScaleTween;
    private final IntTween xOffsetTween;
    private final DoubleTween yScaleTween;
    private final IntTween yOffsetTween;

    public ScaleOffset getCurrentValue() {
        return new ScaleOffset(xScaleTween.getCurrentValue(), xOffsetTween.getCurrentValue(), yScaleTween.getCurrentValue(), yOffsetTween.getCurrentValue());
    }

    public ScaleOffsetTween(ScaleOffset start, ScaleOffset end, long time, TweenFunction function, boolean removeOnComplete) {
        super(removeOnComplete);
        xScaleTween = new DoubleTween(start.xScale(), end.xScale(), time, function, false);
        xOffsetTween = new IntTween(start.xOffset(), end.xOffset(), time, function, false);
        yScaleTween = new DoubleTween(start.yScale(), end.yScale(), time, function, false);
        yOffsetTween = new IntTween(start.yOffset(), end.yOffset(), time, function, false);

        addChildren(xScaleTween, xOffsetTween, yScaleTween, yOffsetTween);
    }
}

docs.title: 首次使用
docs.text:
本章节将会演示初始化库,嵌入渲染循环并且在屏幕上显示一个全屏的白色矩形

本UI库没有自己的渲染循环, 它通常直接嵌入宿主程序中.

当你创建了一个窗口并持有窗口句柄的时候,你可以这么做以初始化库:

Window window = Window.from(windowHandle); //将会注册GLFW回调
window.init(RenderProviderType.OPENGL); //将会初始化渲染后端

Warning

你应该在glfwPollEvent的线程调用Window.from,在渲染线程调用window.init

并且不要在Window.from之后注册任何GLFW回调, 你的回调应该在Window.from之前注册

初始化Window后,你可以获取GUI节点根:

NodeRoot root = window.getNodeRoot();

然后,你可以在你的渲染循环里:

//在渲染UI之前的代码...
root.render();
//在渲染UI之后的代码,例如glfwSwapBuffers()...

这样,UI库就可以正常执行渲染了

现在,我们将在屏幕上渲染一个覆盖全屏的长方形:

ScaleOffset position = ScaleOffset.ZERO; //位置在左上角
ScaleOffset size = ScaleOffset.fromScale(1, 1); //占满父节点,这里父节点是NodeRoot,占满父节点就是占满全屏
Frame frame = new Frame(position, size); //新建Frame对象
root.addChild(frame); //将Frame挂到节点根

ScaleOffset可以在核心概念章节查看详细用法

Warning

上列代码不要在渲染循环中每次都新建,因为我们是保留模式UI库,这会导致每帧都有一个新Frame挂到节点树上,性能严重降低

如果没有任何问题的话,你应该在屏幕上看到一个覆盖全屏的白色长方形
